title: Solutions Development Architect
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Sr Principal, Analyst (Semiconductor Memory – NAND Flash/DRAM)
description:
**About this Role:**
 Analysts create must\-have insights for our clients through published research and client interaction. You will meet with clients every day: on the phone, in a videoconference, from the stage at a Gartner event, or face\-to\-face during a sales support visit. In every interaction, you will help clients overcome their challenges and perform better.
   

  

 As part of Gartner’s Emerging Market Dynamics Group, you will equip leaders in the semiconductor memory industry with indispensable insights, advice, and tools to achieve their mission\-critical priorities and build the successful organizations of tomorrow. You will own the authoritative quantitative view of the global DRAM, HBM and NAND Flash markets and convert supply, demand, pricing and technology signals into decision\-useful market intelligence.
   

  

**What You’ll do:**
* Develop and maintain global DRAM, HBM and NAND supply\-demand forecasts, including bit growth, wafer capacity, utilization, yields, inventories and pricing.
* Track supplier capacity, capex, technology transitions and competitive positioning across Samsung, SK hynix, Micron, Kioxia, SanDisk and emerging suppliers.
* Forecast market size, revenue, units/bits, ASPs and supplier market share by major memory segment.
* Quantify demand across AI/data center, enterprise storage, PCs, smartphones, automotive and other major applications.
* Track DRAM technology transitions including DDR5, LPDDR and HBM generations, capacity allocation and HBM production economics.
* Track NAND transitions including layer scaling, TLC/QLC mix, enterprise SSD adoption, client SSD and embedded/mobile applications.
* Analyze memory cycles, inventory corrections, pricing inflections and structural supply\-demand changes.
* Maintain quarterly market trackers, forecast models, source databases and scenario analysis.
* Provide evidence\-based written responses and support VP/market\-intelligence\-level client conversations.
* Partner with analysts covering AI accelerators, foundry, advanced packaging and storage to quantify cross\-market dependencies.
* Identify early indicators that could invalidate the current forecast and proactively revise assumptions and outlooks.
* Actively participate in appropriate Gartner global research communities for formal and in\-formal knowledge sharing sessions.


**Core Quantitative Coverage :**
 You are capable of modeling and forecasting:
   

  

* DRAM / HBM: wafer capacity and utilization, bit output and bit growth, die density and technology\-node transitions, HBM stacks, capacity and GB/device, DDR/LPDDR/HBM mix, supplier market share, contract and spot pricing, revenue and ASP, and AI\-server and accelerator\-driven memory demand.
* NAND Flash: wafer capacity and utilization, bits/wafer and layer transitions, TLC/QLC mix, bit supply and demand, supplier market share, pricing and revenue, enterprise/client SSD units and capacity, mobile/embedded NAND, and AI\-storage demand including RAG, KV\-cache and checkpointing use cases.
* Research Boundaries: This role owns the semiconductor memory\-market quantitative truth layer. It does not own broad AI accelerator strategy, semiconductor foundry strategy, advanced packaging market strategy, server/storage\-system architecture, or the general semiconductor equipment coverage. However, the analyst must quantify how developments in these adjacent markets affect memory demand, supply and economics.


**Job Requirements :**
**What You Will Need**
* Educational Qualification:
* BE/BTech from Grade A engineering colleges with specialization in Electronics, or Semiconductors, or software engineering.
* Graduate \+ MBA (Marketing or Ops) from leading A \& B\-schools is desirable.
* Work experience:
* 7\-10\+ years minimum experience in semiconductor memory, market intelligence, product planning, business planning, forecasting or industry research.
* Domain knowledge/Business Acumen:
* Deep expertise in DRAM and/or NAND Flash, with the ability to develop credible coverage across both.
* Strong understanding of memory manufacturing economics, technology migration, supplier capacity and pricing cycles.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain quantitative market models and forecasts.
* Experience with memory suppliers, semiconductor market\-research firms, OEMs/hyperscalers or relevant supply\-chain organizations preferred.
* Awareness of the major issues across the IT, technology, semiconductor and electronics industry affecting software technologies and competitive landscape, and an eagerness to learn more.
* MS Office Tools:
* Ability to design, develop and maintain large Excel models for market share analysis and forecasting, and strong working knowledge of other MS Office tools such as Word and Power Point for writing and presenting analysis.
* Project management skills:
* Ability to manage time, keep projects on schedule and resolve issues and deliver all client deliverables in a timely manner.
* Communication skills:
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex market data into clear implications.
* Written: A strong writing ability is mandatory. Writing efforts will require stating/staking positions, justifying those positions with facts and providing actionable analysis and recommendations.
* Oral: Skills to converse on telephone, face to face, and on\-stage, with the ability to explain complex concepts concisely.
* Problem Solving:
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to think creatively, independently, and efficiently to diagnose and contextualize issues, exhibit critical\-thinking and problem\-solving capabilities, including working on estimation problems and provide insightful and original analysis.
* Interpersonal skills:
* Ability to communicate, engage, and develop cordial professional relationships with analysts, key initiative leaders, team managers, and clients with a compelling and enthusiastic attitude that drives clients to action and guides them to success.
* Strong client presence and ability to relate to a variety of company and personality types is a must \- ability to represent Gartner research, methodology and strategies at multiple levels (Board, C\-Level, Business Unit and Operational) and multiple client organization types (End User Client, Investors, Technology and Service Providers, Resellers, Channel Partners).
* Ability to organize effectively, drive for results, collaborate productively, coach and develop colleagues where required – provide constructive feedback to peers as well as be receptive to feedback from peers.
* Complete ownership mindset, professional maturity and intellectual curiosity, ability to embrace change and act with integrity, and follow internal processes and policies, including, HR, IT and Finance.


**Who you are :**
 To thrive in this role, it helps if you are obsessed with your topic! Gartner analysts are correctly viewed as
 **THE** 
 experts. This means that:
   

  

* You know your technologies, markets, vendors, trends, management practices, etc., well and be able to see the forest and the trees.
* You are an excellent collaborator with the ability to quickly build rapport and gain client trust.
* You are a confident presenter with a high level of executive presence (prior experience with speaking engagements is a plus).
* You are an analytical thinker with the ability to process information quickly and make actionable recommendations.
* You are willing to challenge conventional norms and views.


**Who are we?**
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
   

  

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
   

  

 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
   

  

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
 At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
   

  

 It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
   

  

**What do we offer?**

title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services
description:
The Engagement Manager is the delivery lead on our enterprise programmes.
 




  






 Our engagements increasingly run through to the systems that execute the pricing. A current programme covers a new packaging model, a new commercial model, and a migration from Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud, working with the client's executive team, their systems integrator, and stakeholders across Sales, Deal Desk, Finance and RevOps. You would start there and take on further engagements as they come.
 




  






 You own whether a programme lands. You are in the working sessions, you hold what was decided, you translate commercial intent into requirements the integrator can build against, and you check that what gets built is what was asked for.
 




  






 Roughly 60% of the role is delivery and programme management. The other 40% is turning commercial decisions into business requirements: stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases and test scenarios. We write business requirements, not technical specifications. You will not be asked to write code or configure Salesforce. You do need to follow a systems discussion closely enough to know when something carries commercial consequence.
 




  





 Responsibilities
 

  





 Delivery and programme management
 
* **The quarterback.** 

 Lead delivery across the client, the systems integrator and the Monetizely team, aligned to a programme plan you own and maintain.
* **Own the record.** 

 Decisions, actions, owners and deadlines. The standard is that Monetizely is never the party asking the client or the integrator what was agreed.
* **Run the cadence.** 

 Working sessions, standing calls, design reviews. You set the agenda and you close the loop.
* **Escalate early.** 

 Identify drift, ambiguity and slippage before it becomes a problem, and raise it with a recommendation attached.
* **Client relationships.** 

 Build and hold multi\-level stakeholder relationships across commercial, finance and systems functions.



  





 Requirements and quality
 
* **Translate commercial intent into requirements.** 

 Business\-level stories, acceptance criteria and edge cases that an integrator can build from without guessing.
* **Hold the coverage view.** 

 Check what has actually been delivered against what was specified, release by release, and raise gaps in writing before they reach testing. This is the function our clients value most.
* **Design test scenarios** 

 and track what has and has not been verified.
* **Produce the written work clients read:** 

 status, recaps, recommendations, escalations.



 Minimum qualifications
 
* Significant experience delivering complex, multi\-phase enterprise software implementations, in professional services, delivery or consulting at an enterprise SaaS company
* Experience running engagements with American and European enterprise clients, including at executive level
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams to deliver enterprise programmes
* Excellent written and spoken English, and sound judgement about what can and cannot be said to a client



 Preferred qualifications
 
* **Strategic advisory.** 

 Demonstrated focus on the why behind a business requirement over the technical how of its implementation.
* **Influential leadership.** 

 Proven ability to command executive presence and lead technical teams through influence rather than direct reporting authority.
* **Proactive problem solving.** 

 You treat a business problem as a puzzle to be solved rather than a metric to report.
* **Communication.** 

 Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Commercial exposure to pricing, packaging, quoting, discounting or renewals
* Salesforce, CPQ or Revenue Cloud familiarity
* Experience working alongside a systems integrator
* Engineering/Science/Analytics background preferred



 The shape of the role
 


 This is a hands\-on role. You will be in the meetings, writing the requirements and maintaining the record yourself. There is no team beneath you today, though there will be as we grow, and the person who does this well will build it.
 




  






 It sits in professional services rather than customer success. The focus is on delivering the programme itself, rather than on adoption, account health or renewals, which sit elsewhere.
   






 Working arrangement
 
* Full\-time, based in Delhi NCR. This is a hard requirement.
* Daily overlap with UK hours and frequent overlap with US hours. The working day typically runs from early afternoon into the evening IST.
* Client confidentiality applies from day one.



  





  





 About Monetizely
 


 Monetizely is a pricing strategy consultancy built by operators with nearly three decades of combined leadership in Product Management, Product Marketing and Pricing at companies including Zoom, Twilio, LinkedIn, Squarespace, Medallia and Microsoft. We are the authors of
 
*Price to Scale* 

 and teach a top\-rated course on SaaS, Agentic and AI Pricing Strategy and Monetization.
 




  






 We work with software companies from Seed stage to post\-IPO on how they package, price and monetize. Increasingly that work does not stop at strategy. We take the pricing model through to the systems that run it: packaging, quoting, discounting, approvals, renewals and amendments, and the CRM and CPQ platforms underneath. We call it monetization engineering.

description:

 AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high\-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go\-to\-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
   

  

 The Field Application Engineer will be the technical interface for AMD’s commercial products with commercial end customers in the INDIA region. As an Engineer, the role will be responsible for technical support for AMD’s commercial products, particularly commercial client and workstation. In this position, the individual will help AMD drive a new era of commercial computing by engaging with large INDIA end customers to demonstrate how AMD technology can be used to address the needs of their business. The role will provide technical support for AMD’s commercial pipeline with a special focus on pre\-sales and development support activity as opportunities transition from opportunity to deployment. Building confidence with key customer influencers and overcoming technical objections will be critical for success in the role. Post\-sales technical support is also required as the account encounters technical issues. The role will be expected to handle technical escalations that may occur, align with AMD’s OEM partner support teams, and accelerate resolutions. The Engineer must have a strong technical knowledge base and skill\-set but be equally effective in communication with both customers and internal AMD stakeholders. Must be proficient in troubleshooting common client, and workstation applications and workloads on AMD hardware with priority end customers.
   

  

**The Primary Focus Of The FAE Will Be To**
* Develop technical relationships with target end customer accounts and OEM partners

 This position will require a broad technical understanding of client CPUs/GPUs, and platform architecture and the development process needed to successfully win client and workstation opportunities with end customers. The position may require specialized knowledge of microprocessor architectures, commercial ecosystem environments including Operating systems (Windows, Linux), compilers, drivers, benchmarks, and targeted applications that may be used to validate client and workstation platforms for various target markets.
   

  

**The Customer Field Support Engineer In This Role Will**

* Provide hands\-on, expert\-level technical assistance to end customer development and software teams
* Design and manage the execution of evaluation plans to ensure a quality solution is delivered
* Be a credible subject matter expert to end customer on direct and indirect product capabilities.
* Other related duties as assigned


**Job Requirements**
* The preferred candidate should have a combination of relevant academic and professional experience. Degree should be technology related bachelor's degree or other technical discipline (e.g. Engineering or Computer Science) or equivalent combination of training and experience. Requires knowledge in one or more of the following areas: CPU and system architecture, benchmarks, and platform enablement. At least 4 years of system architecture and/or platform development experience
* Must demonstrate excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to manage complex problems involving multi\-disciplined, cross\-functional teams
* Must have strong experience in leading IT/Technology sales engineers
* High energy, results driven mentality with strong people/leadership skills.

* Good hands on and working knowledge of client hardware ecosystem
* Hands on experience in the setup and configuration of systems including software, power settings, BIOS, drivers

* This position requires an individual with excellent organizational and communication skills with a good balance of hardware, architecture and software expertise. Must be a team player with excellent collaborative skills and superior written and oral communication skills

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an
 **education–to\-industry partner** 
 building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry\- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real\-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms.
 **Our model combines academic learning with hands\-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.** 
 Today, Virohan has trained 13,000\+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
 



 Backed by
 **global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),** 
 we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest\-growing sectors.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Signing a university partnership is the easy part. Making it work — filling seats, running the programme well, placing students, keeping the Registrar and the Chancellor’s office confident that the partnership was a good decision — is where the business is actually won or lost. And it all comes due once a year, at renewal.
 



 This role owns that. You are the single point of accountability for a portfolio of partner universities: their success, their satisfaction, and their renewal. You are the bridge between the institution and every internal team at Virohan — admissions, academics, placements, operations, finance — translating in both directions, setting expectations honestly, and making sure what we promised is what actually happens on campus.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




 •
 **Renewal targets\-** 
 Carry and deliver the end\-of\-year renewal goal for every university in your portfolio. Renewals are the number you are measured on, and you own the plan to get there from day one of the year — not in the last quarter.
 



 •
 **Partner success\-** 
 Define what success looks like for each partner — enrolment, programme delivery, student outcomes, placements — then track it, report it, and drive the internal action that moves it.
 



 •
 **The relationship map\-** 
 Build trusted relationships across each institution: Registrar, Deans, HoDs, admissions teams, and the leadership who ultimately sign the renewal. Never be dependent on a single contact.
 



 •
 **Expectation setting\-** 
 Agree what Virohan will deliver and what the university will deliver, in writing, up front — and hold both sides to it. Most partnership failures are expectation failures.
 



 •
 **Internal advocacy and escalation\-** 
 Represent the partner\&\#39;s reality inside Virohan and get cross\- functional teams to act, without having authority over them. Escalate early, with evidence, and follow through to closure.
 



 •
 **Business reviews\-** 
 Run a disciplined cadence of reviews with each partner — a clear numbers\-led narrative on what is working, what is not, and what happens next. These reviews are what make the renewal conversation a formality.
 



 •
 **Commercial conversations\-** 
 Lead renewal negotiations, pricing and scope discussions, and identify expansion within existing partners — new programmes, new campuses, higher intake.
 



 •
 **Risk detection\-** 
 Spot an at\-risk account two quarters out, not two weeks out. Build the early\-warning signals into how you run the portfolio.
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




 •
 **3\-6 years of experience in business roles,** 
 with real ownership of a number — retention, renewal, revenue or growth. You have been accountable for an outcome, not just for supporting one.
 



 •
 **Outstanding communication.** 
 You are credible in a Registrar\&\#39;s office and clear in an internal escalation. You can say no, deliver bad news early, and still keep the relationship strong.
 



 •
 **Logical, structured thinking.** 
 You diagnose why an account is underperforming rather than reacting to the loudest complaint, and you can separate a real problem from a symptom.
 



 •
 **Comfort with numbers.** 
 You are fluent in spreadsheets and you run your portfolio off data —
 



 enrollment funnels, placement rates, revenue per partner, renewal probability. You build your own view rather than waiting for a report.
 



 •
 **Strong AI leverage.** 
 You already use Claude and similar AI tools to prepare for reviews, analyse partner data, draft proposals and cut your admin time. We want someone who compounds their own output.
 



 •
 **Clear writing.** 
 Review decks, partner emails, MoU scopes and internal escalations that are
 



 unambiguous and get acted on.
 



 •
 **Ownership and follow\-through.** 
 You close loops without being chased. When something falls between two teams, you pick it up.
 



 •
 **Willingness to travel.** 
 You will be on partner campuses regularly. The relationship is not built over email.
 



  





**This role is probably not for you if** 




 • You see account management as relationship maintenance rather than a number you carry.
 



 • You are uncomfortable pushing internal teams, or you avoid difficult conversations with a partner until they escalate.
 



 • You would rather report on the portfolio than be accountable for it.
 



  





**What you get** 




 •
 **A clear number and real ownership** 
 — your portfolio, your renewal target, your call on how to get there.
 



 •
 **Senior exposure** 
 , internally with Virohan’s leadership and externally with university leadership, from your first month.
 



 •
 **Work that matters** 
 — every partnership that renews is another few hundred students with a route to a real healthcare job.
 



  





**If you believe in making an impact on society and are keen to be a part of the fast growing healthcare education sector, we would be delighted to hear from you!**

title: SaaS Solution Consultant: Construction Technology
description:
Solution Consultant – SaaS \| ConstructionTech / PropTech
 
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 3–6 years
 



**Industry:** 
 ConstructionTech / PropTech / Construction ERP / B2B SaaS preferred
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹4\.8–6\.0 LPA \+ Incentives
 


 About Bildwell
 
 Bildwell is a ConstructionTech SaaS platform helping contractors and construction businesses improve project visibility, BOQ management, quantity and material planning, procurement control, execution discipline and project cost visibility.
 



 Bildwell connects commercial, technical, procurement and execution workflows so that construction businesses can move from fragmented spreadsheets and disconnected processes towards structured, data\-driven project operations.
 


 The Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **Solution Consultant** 
 who combines a strong understanding of construction workflows with the ability to understand customer business problems, translate them into relevant use cases and demonstrate how Bildwell can create measurable business value.
 



 This is a
 **solutioning and consultative pre\-sales role** 
 , not just a product\-demo position.
 



 The candidate should be technically comfortable discussing construction quantities, BOQs, estimation, materials, procurement, contracts, project execution and cost control with contractors, project teams, quantity surveyors, procurement teams and business owners.
 



 The objective is to bridge:
 



**Construction Domain → Business Problem → Technology Solution** 




**The candidate should be capable of understanding not only what a customer wants from the software, but also why a particular construction, quantity or procurement workflow exists and how Bildwell should be applied to that workflow.** 



 Educational \& Technical Qualification
 
**Preferred Qualification: M.Tech / M.E. in Civil Engineering** 
 , preferably with a specialisation in one of the following:
 


* Construction Engineering \& Management
* Construction Technology \& Management
* Quantity Surveying
* Contracts \& Cost Management
* Building Engineering \& Management
* Infrastructure Engineering / Infrastructure Management
* Construction Project Management
* Construction Economics
* Project Planning \& Controls
* Estimation and Cost Engineering
* Construction Materials and Material Management
* Procurement and Contract Management



 Candidates with a
 **B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering combined with strong relevant experience** 
 in Quantity Surveying, Estimation, Contracts, Procurement, Cost Control or Construction Project Management may also be considered.
 



 The educational requirement is important because the Solution Consultant must be able to understand and discuss technical construction workflows and not operate merely as a generic SaaS salesperson.
 


 Core Domain Knowledge Expected
 
 The candidate should have academic or practical understanding of several of the following:
 


* BOQ preparation and interpretation
* Quantity take\-off
* Measurement and quantity reconciliation
* Estimation and costing
* Rate analysis
* Budget versus actual quantities
* Construction specifications
* Material requirement planning
* BOQ\-to\-BOM interpretation
* Material consumption
* Material reconciliation
* Procurement planning
* Purchase requisitions
* RFQs
* Vendor quotations
* Technical and commercial comparison
* Purchase Orders
* Goods Receipt / GRN
* Material inspection
* Vendor management
* Contracts and tendering
* Project planning
* Site execution
* Progress measurement
* Contractor / subcontractor management
* Project cost control



 The candidate does
 **not need operational experience across every area** 
 , but should have sufficient technical grounding to understand these concepts quickly and hold credible discussions with construction professionals.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Understand customer construction workflows, operational pain points, business requirements and commercial objectives.
* Analyse how customers currently manage BOQs, quantities, materials, procurement, project execution, subcontractors, progress and cost control.
* Understand BOQ structures, item descriptions, quantities, units of measurement, specifications, material requirements and their relationship with execution.
* Understand the relationship between:



**BOQ → Quantity → Material Requirement → Procurement → Consumption → Progress → Cost** 



* Develop relevant customer\-specific use cases and solution narratives based on actual construction and business requirements.
* Conduct customised product demonstrations and simulations using realistic construction projects, BOQs, materials and procurement scenarios.
* Configure demo scenarios that reflect the customer's actual operating environment instead of conducting generic feature demonstrations.
* Translate Bildwell's product capabilities into clear operational, financial and commercial value propositions.
* Demonstrate how better quantity visibility, material planning, procurement and execution control can improve project margins and reduce operational leakage.
* Engage with customer teams including founders, CXOs, project heads, quantity surveyors, estimators, procurement teams, commercial teams, project managers and site teams.
* Work closely with Sales to qualify opportunities and identify the customer's actual business problem before proposing a solution.
* Support Sales in solution design, opportunity qualification, proposals and commercial discussions.
* Prepare solution presentations, use cases, demo flows, process diagrams, business scenarios and supporting sales collateral.
* Capture customer feedback, requirements, functional gaps and industry\-specific requirements in a structured manner.
* Translate customer requirements into clear functional requirements for discussion with the Product and Engineering teams.
* Identify whether a customer requirement should be addressed through configuration, workflow changes, product functionality or future product development.
* Build reusable industry\-specific demo scenarios and solution assets for different construction segments.
* Develop expertise across contractor categories such as civil contracting, interiors, fit\-outs, MEP, design \& build, turnkey projects, EPC and other project\-based construction businesses.


 Ideal Profile
 * 3–6 years of experience in SaaS Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, Business Analysis, Product Consulting, Construction Technology, Quantity Surveying, Estimation, Procurement, Project Management or related functions.
* M.Tech / M.E. in Civil Engineering with specialisation in Construction Engineering \& Management, Construction Technology \& Management, Quantity Surveying, Contracts \& Cost Management or a related discipline is strongly preferred.
* Experience in ConstructionTech, PropTech, Construction ERP, Project Management Software or B2B SaaS would be highly valuable.
* Strong understanding of construction workflows involving BOQs, quantities, procurement, materials, project execution and cost control.
* Ability to read and understand a BOQ and discuss its operational and commercial implications.
* Ability to understand construction terminology, quantity logic and procurement workflows without relying entirely on the customer to explain technical concepts.
* Strong analytical ability and structured problem\-solving approach.
* Strong presentation, communication and storytelling skills.
* Ability to understand a business problem and convert it into:



**Problem → Use Case → Workflow → Solution → Demo → Business Value** 



* Comfortable engaging with founders, CXOs, business heads, project teams, quantity surveyors, procurement professionals and functional teams.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Commercially aware, structured, curious and hands\-on.
* Comfortable working in a growing product company where solution consulting will also contribute to product discovery and market intelligence.


 What This Role Is Not
 
 This is
 **not a scripted product\-demo role** 
 where the candidate simply walks customers through software screens.
 



 The candidate is expected to understand:
 


* What is the customer's current process?
* Where is the operational or commercial problem?
* What construction, quantity or procurement logic is involved?
* How should Bildwell address that problem?
* How should the solution be demonstrated?
* What measurable value can the customer derive from it?


 Success in the Role
 
 The right candidate should be able to move a customer conversation from:
 



**“Here is what the product does.”** 




**to:** 




**“Here is how your current construction, quantity, material or procurement problem can be solved, how the workflow would operate in your business, and what operational or commercial value it can create.”** 




**Over time, the Solution Consultant should become capable of understanding a customer's construction business sufficiently well to design a relevant Bildwell solution without requiring every workflow to be explained by the Product team.** 



 Why Join Bildwell
 
 This role provides an opportunity to work at the intersection of:
 



**Construction Domain Expertise \+ SaaS \+ Business Consulting \+ Product Strategy** 




**You will work directly with customers, Sales and Product teams and help shape Bildwell's solution\-selling methodology, industry use cases and product evolution.** 



* **Join Bildwell and help build the solution\-selling engine for a growing ConstructionTech SaaS business.**

**Your work profile** 




 Professionals in M\&A group offer both advisory and deployment services that provide clients with comprehensive solutions to help them better manage the critical business functions.

 The primary role is to make direct contributions to the engagement team by assisting financial services clients (preferably banking) on Organization Readiness and integration or carve\-outs in a deal / M\&A scenario.
 



  





**Delivery of specific capability in FS M\&A: DT \& PMI** 




**Organization readiness in a post deal integration:** 



* Understand the integration vision and strategy set out in the deal objective
* Work with C\-suite executives, business and internal firm stakeholders to identify integration guiding principles
* Identify the target operating model, organization construct and governance model for the consolidated entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100\), desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in Integration Management office (IMO) for end\-to\-end program management of workstreams involved in the Integration process



  





**Integration support for post\-deal activities:** 



* Program / Integration/ Transformation management office planning and readiness
* Day 1 / 100 Readiness planning
* Assess the IT landscape and identify the areas of synergies / dis\-synergies
* Vendor evaluation and selection
* IT spend analysis (including vendor contract reviews for any hidden transactional costs), provide recommendations on the cost efficiencies
* Bid formulation and vendor management
* Facilitate execution of the post deal integration of IT operations and organization



  





**Carve\-out and separation:** 



* Develop the separation strategy and assess the separation readiness
* Evaluate financial and operational entanglements / interdependencies
* Identify the operating model, organization construct and governance model for the re\-structured entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100\) and desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in managing the Separation Management Office (SMO) across the workstreams
* Assess the TSA requirements, prepare TSA schedules and TSA exit strategies
* Cost modelling for one\-time and recurring costs due to separation (stranded cost, standalone costs etc.)
* Define step\- wise separation road map



  





**Commercial and Operational Diligence and Transformation:** 



* Evaluate the strategic and commercial feasibility of a deal / transaction
* Evaluate the current business capabilities and identify red flags on operational issues/risks
* Assess the Post deal consolidation and transformation opportunities
* Leverage industry best practices and Deloitte accelerators to define methodological approach to consolidation / separation
* Undertake detailed functional integration planning (e.g. Sales and Marketing, operations, Finance, IT, HR etc.) for Day 1 /100 and End state
* Support delivery of functional plans



  





**Synergy / dis\-synergy assessment \& delivery:** 



* Identify areas of potential synergies / dis\-synergies and establish the degree of integration required
* Define road map for delivery of synergies and advise on synergy benefits tracking
* Work with functional leads on Synergy realization



  





  





**Key skills required:** 



* Candidate should be able to demonstrate experience of working on large transformations including pre\-deal or post\-deal M\&A transactions in FS / banking space
* Candidate should possess good knowledge of banking value chain from a business standpoint including experience of working within one or more banking functions, or as an advisor working with one or more banking functions
* A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting with 3 \- 12 years of relevant experience in financial services industry preferably banking

title: Cold Outreach Customer Acquisition Intern
description:
**Company Description:** 




 FabWise is building a new way to get custom physical work done.
 



 Today, getting something made, installed or repaired often means finding local vendors, comparing quotes, coordinating measurements and materials, and chasing execution. We believe this should be as simple as buying any modern service.
 



 FabWise is building a managed service for custom fabrication, starting with glass work across Gurugram and Noida, and eventually expanding into metal, aluminium and other custom fabrication categories.
 



 Customers deal with one brand. FabWise handles the requirement, pricing, measurement, coordination and accountability, while a network of specialised fabricators and installers execute the work .
 



 We are an early\-stage, hands\-on company, and we're looking for people who want to help build the company rather than simply perform a predefined role.
 



  




**Role Description:** 
 Growth \& Customer Acquisition Intern
 
 FabWise is looking for a highly proactive Growth \& Customer Acquisition Intern to help us acquire our next 100 customers.
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You will work directly with the founder and be responsible for finding potential customers, reaching out to businesses, generating conversations and turning those conversations into real opportunities.
 


 What you’ll do
 * Build targeted prospect lists of businesses, offices, facility managers, property managers, interior contractors and other potential FabWise customers.
* Conduct high\-volume outreach through WhatsApp, calls, email and other relevant channels.
* Research each prospect and personalise outreach where useful.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and maintain the sales pipeline.
* Identify genuine fabrication requirements and qualify potential customers.
* Pass qualified customers to the FabWise team.
* Experiment with new customer acquisition channels and outreach strategies.
* Track all outreach and results.
* Help build repeatable processes for customer acquisition as FabWise scales.



  




 What we're looking for
 * Extremely proactive and comfortable with cold outreach.
* Strong communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Comfortable making calls and starting conversations with strangers.
* Resourceful : you should be able to find the right people and contact information without being spoon\-fed.
* Data\-oriented and willing to track numbers every day.
* Persistent without being pushy.
* Interested in startups, sales, growth and building something from an early stage.
* Prior sales, business development or startup experience is a plus, but not required.



  




 How we measure success
 
 You will not be measured by the number of posts you create or hours you sit online.
 



 Your core metrics will be:
 



**Prospects contacted → conversations → qualified opportunities → site visits → customers.** 




  




 What you’ll get
 * Direct exposure to building an early\-stage company.
* Work directly with the founder.
* Hands\-on experience in sales, growth and customer acquisition.
* Freedom to test ideas and build your own acquisition systems.
* Opportunity to take on significantly more responsibility as FabWise grows.



**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR
 



**Type:** 
 Internship
 



**Duration:** 
 1\-2 months, with potential for a longer\-term role based on performance.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong Communication and Customer Service skills for engaging prospects, addressing questions, and building initial trust.
* Research and Community Outreach abilities to identify target segments, gather market insights, and connect with local businesses or communities.
* Clear Writing skills to craft concise outreach messages, email templates, and simple follow\-up communication.
* Comfort with phone\-based and in\-person outreach, including cold calling and face\-to\-face conversations.
* Basic familiarity with CRM tools or spreadsheets (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets) for organizing leads and tracking outreach activities.
* Self\-motivated, disciplined work approach with the ability to follow structured processes and meet daily activity targets.
* Interest in sales, business development, or startup environments; prior internship or project experience in these areas is an advantage.
* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

The program also builds partnerships with organisations across sectors to curate relevant opportunities and connect them with students.
   

  

 Currently embedded within government school systems across Haryana, Punjab, and Uttarakhand, Maadhyam has reached over 4,500 students within its first three months and continues to expand access to opportunities for young people who often have limited guidance and exposure.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Specialist \- Outreach \& Partnerships to build and manage a strong network of organisations and educational institutions that can create meaningful opportunities for students in the Maadhyam community.
   

  

 This is a fast paced, high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys building relationships, driving outreach, and creating partnerships that lead to tangible outcomes.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Research what opportunities already exist in the government school ecosystem.
* Build and manage partnerships with corporates, educational institutions, NGOs, CSR teams, and ecosystem organisations.
* Proactively identify and outreach potential partners/ institutions through calls, emails, meetings, and networking.
* Source opportunities such as internships, scholarships, mentorships, exposure visits, apprenticeships, and jobs for Maadhyam students and alumni.
* Manage partner relationships and ensure smooth coordination of engagements.
* Work closely with internal teams to understand student needs and align partnership efforts.
* Track outreach, partnerships, and opportunities while continuously improving partnership processes.
* The role is based out of Delhi/ NCR and requires significant travel.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 5\-7 years of experience in partnerships, outreach, or similar roles, 2\-3 years having worked in product, marketing or business development is an added advantage.
* Strong communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills.
* Comfortable with taking initiative and experimenting
* High ownership, research \& execution mindset, and ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and building partnerships from the ground up. Tenacity in following up and nurturing these relationships.
* Experience in engaging with universities, colleges, training/skilling institutes, foundations, family offices is a plus.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to build partnerships that directly expand pathways for young people, helping them access education, livelihoods, and entrepreneurship opportunities while contributing to Udhyam's mission of Making Bharat Entrepreneurial.

title: Guest Advisory Associate (Arabic)
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for an
 **Arabic\-speaking Guest Advisory Associate** 
 to turn customer interest into confident decisions and successful conversions.
   

  

 You’ll be one of the first people travellers speak to at Atlys, understanding what they need, helping them navigate their options, and building trust through clear, thoughtful conversations.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing role for someone who can combine strong communication with commercial instinct, follow through consistently, and move quickly in a high\-volume environment.
 **Fluency in Arabic and English is essential** 
 , as you’ll work closely with Arabic\-speaking customers.
   

  

**The Job**
* Engage and qualify potential customers across calls, chats and email by understanding their travel needs and guiding them toward the right Atlys solution.
* Communicate with Arabic\-speaking customers in Arabic and English, adapting your approach to ensure conversations are clear, natural and effective.
* Explain our products and visa processes clearly so customers understand their options, feel confident in their decision and know what happens next.
* Drive leads through to conversion through thoughtful follow\-ups, objection handling and consistent ownership of the customer journey.
* Learn from customer conversations by identifying recurring questions, pain points and signals that can improve conversion and the overall experience.
* Work closely across teams with Marketing, Fulfilment and Product while keeping lead and interaction data accurate and up to date.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 1\+ years of experience in pre\-sales, sales, customer success or another customer\-facing role.
* Are fluent in Arabic and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills in both languages.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, and can simplify complex information into easy, human conversations.
* Are persuasive without being pushy, with strong empathy and the ability to understand what a customer actually needs.
* Are proactive, organised and comfortable managing multiple conversations and follow\-ups in a fast\-paced environment.
* Are comfortable working a 6\-day schedule, with Monday to Friday in\-office and a rotational WFH shift on either Saturday or Sunday.


*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

 Location: Delhi
 



 Experience: 4–7 years
 



 Industry Preference: Luxury furniture / interiors / premium retail / lifestyle / hospitality / real estate
 



 CTC Budget: ₹7–10 LPA, depending on experience and profile
 



  





 ABOUT COMPANY
 



  





 Its a premium furniture, interiors, styling and art curation brand, creating thoughtfully designed spaces for babies, children and adults. We work with discerning clients and HNI families and are expanding our interior styling and turnkey offerings.
 



  





 We are looking for a polished and highly organised Client Relationship \& Order Management Manager who can take ownership of the complete customer journey—from the first enquiry through conversion, order execution, delivery and post\-sale relationship management.
 



  





 ROLE OVERVIEW
 



  





 This is a client\-facing and execution\-oriented role.
 



  





 The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that every enquiry is systematically followed up, every converted client is properly managed, every order is tracked through execution, and clients receive timely and professional updates throughout the process.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will combine:
 



  





 Client Relationship Management \+ Sales Follow\-up \+ Order Coordination \+ Data/MIS Management
 



  





 The person should be comfortable dealing with HNI clients and simultaneously managing detailed trackers, reports and multiple ongoing orders.
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Lead Management \& Follow\-up
 



  





 \* Handle incoming enquiries and ensure every lead is properly recorded.
 



 \* Understand client requirements, budgets, timelines and expectations.
 



 \* Maintain a structured lead and follow\-up database.
 



 \* Follow up with prospects systematically until conversion or closure.
 



 \* Ensure no lead is lost due to inadequate or delayed follow\-up.
 



 \* Maintain clear records of enquiry source, requirement, quotation, follow\-up dates and status.
 



 \* Track reasons for lost or inactive leads.
 



  





 2\. Sales \& Conversion
 



  





 \* Follow up on quotations and proposals.
 



 \* Coordinate with the sales/design team wherever required to move an enquiry towards closure.
 



 \* Maintain a clear pipeline of active, pending and converted leads.
 



 \* Track expected closures and provide regular updates to management.
 



 \* Build a strong understanding of TBS Studio’s products, services and positioning.
 



 \* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross\-selling and repeat business.
 



  





 3\. Client Relationship Management
 



  





 \* Act as a key point of contact for clients after enquiry/conversion.
 



 \* Develop strong and professional relationships with HNI and premium clients.
 



 \* Communicate with clients proactively regarding the status of their orders/projects.
 



 \* Ensure communication is polished, personalised and aligned with a premium/luxury brand.
 



 \* Handle client concerns professionally and ensure issues are followed through to resolution.
 



 \* Maintain a high level of discretion and professionalism when dealing with HNI clients.
 



  





 4\. Order \& Execution Management
 



  





 Once an order is confirmed, the candidate will be responsible for tracking its progress.
 



  





 \* Maintain an updated order tracker for every client.
 



 \* Coordinate with production, design, procurement, vendors and logistics.
 



 \* Track production status and expected completion dates.
 



 \* Monitor pending components, customisations and approvals.
 



 \* Identify delays or bottlenecks and escalate them proactively.
 



 \* Ensure internal teams are aligned with promised client timelines.
 



 \* Maintain a clear record of the complete order journey.
 



  





 5\. Delivery \& Installation Coordination
 



  





 \* Coordinate with the logistics/delivery team for dispatch and delivery.
 



 \* Confirm delivery schedules with clients.
 



 \* Ensure all items are ready before dispatch.
 



 \* Track delivery and installation completion.
 



 \* Communicate any delays or changes to clients proactively.
 



 \* Follow up after delivery to ensure client concerns, if any, are addressed.
 



  





 6\. Data, MIS \& Reporting
 



  





 A very important part of this role is maintaining accurate data and providing management with clear reports.
 



  





 The candidate will maintain:
 



  





 \* Lead tracker
 



 \* Follow\-up tracker
 



 \* Conversion report
 



 \* Quotation tracker
 



 \* Order tracker
 



 \* Production status tracker
 



 \* Delivery tracker
 



 \* Pending payment tracker
 



 \* Client status tracker
 



 \* Lost lead report
 



 \* Monthly sales and order MIS
 



  





 The candidate should be able to analyse the data and provide management with meaningful updates rather than simply maintaining spreadsheets.
 



  





 7\. Management Reporting
 



  





 Provide regular reports covering:
 



  





 \* New enquiries
 



 \* Active leads
 



 \* Follow\-ups due
 



 \* Quotations pending
 



 \* Conversion status
 



 \* Orders under execution
 



 \* Production status
 



 \* Delayed orders
 



 \* Upcoming deliveries
 



 \* Client issues
 



 \* Lost leads and reasons
 



 \* Sales/conversion performance
 



  





 IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
 



  





 We are looking for someone who is:
 



  





 \* Highly organised and extremely good with follow\-ups.
 



 \* Strong in client relationship management.
 



 \* Comfortable handling HNI/UHNI and premium customers.
 



 \* Polished, articulate and well presented.
 



 \* Excellent in verbal and written communication.
 



 \* Strong with Excel/Google Sheets and data management.
 



 \* Comfortable preparing MIS and management reports.
 



 \* Detail\-oriented and process\-driven.
 



 \* Able to manage multiple clients/orders simultaneously.
 



 \* Proactive in identifying and resolving issues.
 



 \* Strong at coordination across different departments.
 



 \* Comfortable taking ownership rather than simply passing information.
 



 \* Able to work in a fast\-paced entrepreneurial environment.
 



 \* Commercially aware and focused on conversion and client retention.
 



  





 EXPERIENCE PREFERRED
 



  





 Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:
 



  





 \* Luxury furniture
 



 \* Interior design/interiors
 



 \* Premium/luxury retail
 



 \* Lifestyle brands
 



 \* Hospitality
 



 \* High\-end real estate
 



 \* Architecture/design firms
 



 \* Premium home décor
 



 \* Luxury automotive or other HNI\-facing businesses
 



  





 Experience dealing directly with HNI/UHNI clients will be an advantage.
 



  





 SKILLS REQUIRED
 



  





 Essential:
 



  





 \* Client Relationship Management
 



 \* Sales follow\-up
 



 \* Lead management
 



 \* Order/project coordination
 



 \* Excellent communication
 



 \* Excel / Google Sheets
 



 \* MIS/reporting
 



 \* Strong organisational skills
 



 \* Follow\-up and execution discipline
 



  





 Preferred:
 



  





 \* CRM software experience
 



 \* Experience in luxury/premium segment
 



 \* Experience with furniture/interiors
 



 \* HNI client management experience
 



  





 EDUCATION
 



  





 Graduate in any relevant discipline.
 



  





 Candidates with a background in Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality, Interior Design, Retail Management or related fields may be preferred.
 



  





 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
 



  





 Performance will be evaluated on:
 



  





 \* Lead follow\-up discipline
 



 \* Lead\-to\-conversion performance
 



 \* Sales conversion
 



 \* Accuracy of client/order data
 



 \* Timeliness of MIS reports
 



 \* Order execution tracking
 



 \* On\-time delivery coordination
 



 \* Client communication
 



 \* Resolution of client issues
 



 \* Repeat business and referrals
 



 \* Overall ownership of the client journey
 



  





 PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES
 



  





 The most important qualities we are looking for are:
 



  





 Ownership \| Follow\-through \| Organisation \| Client Sensitivity \| Communication \| Data Discipline \| Proactiveness
 



  





 The candidate should be someone who naturally asks:
 



  





 “What is pending, who is responsible, what is the next action and by when will it be completed?”
 



  





 rather than waiting for someone else to follow up.
 



  





 COMPENSATION
 



  





 ₹7–9LPA CTC, depending on experience, industry background and quality of HNI client\-handling experience.
 



  





 Performance\-linked incentives may be offered based on defined KPIs.

title: Key Account Manager at Fleek
description:
**This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.**
 She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
   

  

 The next step is to speak to Jack.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Key Account Manager
   

  

**Salary**
 Not Disclosed
   

  

**Company Description**
 Fleek is a $25M Series B marketplace backed by a16z, Y Combinator, and eBay, building AI\-native infrastructure for the global secondhand fashion trade.
   

  

**Job Description**
 You will spearhead Fleek's growth in India by identifying and onboarding high\-volume vendors, from aggregators to wholesalers. By digitizing manual supply chains with AI\-driven tools like FleekSort, you will manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of key accounts, negotiating commercial terms and scaling inventory to meet the demands of 50,000 global buyers.
   

  

**Location**
 Delhi, India
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* You are not just managing a book; you are digitizing an entire offline market, giving Indian vendors access to a global audience of 50,000\+ retailers.
* Work at a hyper\-growth Series B startup backed by top\-tier investors like a16z and Burda, tripling in size year\-on\-year since 2022\.
* Leverage FleekSort, a proprietary AI model, to automate cataloging and focus your time on high\-impact strategic relationships and market expansion.


**What You Will Do**
* Source and close major Indian vendor accounts, aiming to build a portfolio averaging $35K\+ in monthly GMV per account.
* Drive 30% month\-on\-month GMV growth in the Indian market while managing account health and bringing down vendor cancellation rates.
* Develop repeatable onboarding playbooks and use AI tools to scale account management efficiency beyond traditional industry standards.


**The ideal candidate**
* Has 3\-5 years of experience in key account management or B2B growth, ideally within marketplaces, e\-commerce, or D2C sectors.
* Demonstrates a proven track record of proactive vendor acquisition and commercial negotiation, specifically regarding pricing, commissions, and payout terms.
* Possesses an AI\-first mindset and a willingness to travel regularly to supply hubs and godowns across India to build deep relationships.


**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

The role will also focus on revenue enhancement through channel partners such as Regional Service Providers (RSPs), Consolidators, Franchise Collection Centres (FCCs), and One\-Stop Centres (OSCs). title: Simulation Specialist, India (R6016)
description:
Shield AI is a venture\-backed defense\-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V\-BAT and X\-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .
   

  

 Shield AI is seeking an International Aechelon / Simulation Sales Specialist to help drive growth of the Aechelon simulation portfolio across international markets. This role will serve as a specialist seller within GTM, partnering with regional sales leaders and account teams to identify, shape, and advance simulation opportunities with customers and partners.
   

  

 The International Aechelon / Simulation Sales Specialist will combine product and market knowledge with strong commercial execution. This person will help position the Aechelon portfolio, support customer engagement, and drive opportunity development across priority international regions. The role is designed for a mission\-focused, customer\-facing professional who can work across functions, support complex pursuits, and help translate simulation capabilities into customer value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Simulation is a key growth lever for Shield AI and an important part of how customers train, rehearse, and prepare for mission success. As Shield AI integrates Aechelon and scales its simulation go\-to\-market efforts, this role will provide dedicated specialist sales support to regional teams and help accelerate growth in international markets.
   

  

 This is an overlay\-style role for someone who can combine solution selling, customer engagement, pursuit support, and strong internal collaboration. Success in this position requires ownership, responsiveness, commercial judgment, and the ability to operate effectively across teams, regions, and time zones.
   

  

**What you will do:**
 Specialist Sales Support
   

  

* Serve as the specialist sales resource for the Aechelon simulation portfolio across priority international markets.
* Partner with regional sales leaders, account owners, and business development teams to identify, qualify, and advance simulation opportunities.
* Support account strategy, opportunity planning, and customer engagement efforts related to the Aechelon portfolio.
* Help drive pipeline development for simulation opportunities and maintain visibility into key pursuits, risks, and next steps.


 Customer and Partner Engagement
   

  

* Participate in customer meetings, capability discussions, demonstrations, and follow\-up actions to help progress opportunities.
* Articulate the value of Aechelon’s simulation offerings in a clear, mission\-relevant, and customer\-oriented way.
* Support relationship development with international defense, government, and partner stakeholders.
* Help connect customer requirements to product capabilities in coordination with sales, product, and technical teams.


 Pursuit and Deal Support
   

  

* Support the development of customer\-facing materials, presentations, proposals, and competitive positioning for simulation opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to support demos, strategic pursuits, bids, and executive engagements.
* Contribute market, customer, and competitive insight to improve positioning and increase win probability.
* Help drive disciplined follow\-up and execution across active opportunities.


 Cross\-Functional Alignment
   

  

* Partner closely with GTM, International, Product, Marketing, and Operations to support simulation growth initiatives.
* Provide field feedback to improve messaging, enablement, campaign focus, and product positioning.
* Contribute to business reporting, opportunity updates, and operating cadence as needed.
* Help ensure internal alignment on priorities, customer engagement plans, and support needs.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* International simulation opportunities are identified early, well supported, and advanced with clear coordination and momentum.
* Regional sales teams have strong specialist support for Aechelon\-related customer discussions, positioning, and pursuits.
* Customer interactions clearly connect simulation capabilities to training, rehearsal, readiness, and mission outcomes.
* Cross\-functional teams are aligned in support of international simulation growth priorities.


**Required Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years of experience in sales, business development, overlay sales, capture support, account management, or related customer\-facing roles.
* Demonstrated ability to support or drive complex technology sales in international, enterprise, government, or defense environments.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to position technical solutions in terms of customer value and mission relevance.
