title: Application Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
We Are
   

  

 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are a DDR/LPDDR Controller System Architecture Specialist who can work directly with customer architects to close real system\-level memory subsystem design decisions.
   

  

 You are comfortable discussing SoC integration, memory subsystem architecture, controller configuration, performance optimization, power management, validation, and interoperability topics. You can help customers evaluate technical trade\-offs and guide them toward practical architecture decisions.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing technical role. You will help customers integrate DDR/LPDDR controller IP into complex SoCs, identify key requirements or gaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable input for Synopsys Product Management, R\&D, and roadmap planning.
   

  

 What You’ll Be Doing
   

  

* Own the technical architecture engagement for DDR/LPDDR controller IP with strategic customers, from early platform requirements through architecture closure and initial deployment readiness.
* Work with customer architects and engineering teams to define suitable DDR/LPDDR memory subsystem configurations for advanced SoC platforms.
* Analyze system\-level trade\-offs related to memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and scalability.
* Translate customer platform requirements and integration constraints into clear feedback for Synopsys Product Management, R\&D, and roadmap planning.
* Support technical closure of design wins by providing architecture guidance, configuration recommendations and competitive positioning.
* Develop reusable technical material, application notes, and customer\-facing guidance based on real engagement experience.
* Train FAEs and customer teams on DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem integration, performance tuning, validation expectations, and deployment best practices.


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Improve the quality of DDR/LPDDR design wins by ensuring customer memory architectures are technically sound before commitment.
* Strengthen Synopsys DDR/LPDDR roadmap by feeding real customer memory subsystem requirements into product planning and R\&D execution.
* Reduce customer integration risk by identifying architecture, performance, power, validation, and bring\-up issues early.
* Help establish Synopsys as a trusted technical partner for next\-generation AI, HPC, mobile, automotive, networking, and edge computing platforms.


 What You’ll Need
   

  

* Bachelors and/or Masters Degree in Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
* 5\+ years of experience in DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem design, SoC integration, silicon validation, systems engineering, applications engineering, or customer\-facing technical leadership.
* Solid understanding of DDR and/or LPDDR controller IP, including memory architecture concepts, controller configuration, scheduling, quality of service, power management, training, validation, or system integration.
* Good system\-level understanding of SoC integration and ability to reason through memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and software/firmware trade\-offs.
* Experience engaging directly with customer architects, design teams, validation teams, and technical decision\-makers.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical recommendations, product feedback, and closure plans.
* Strong technical communication skills, including clear written analysis, structured trade\-off explanation, and ability to align customer, sales, product, and engineering teams.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with Linux, firmware bring\-up, or software\-driven debug of DDR/LPDDR subsystems.
* Familiarity with advanced SoC architectures used in AI, HPC, automotive, mobile, networking, or compute platforms.
* Experience with memory performance analysis, traffic modeling, quality\-of\-service management, memory hierarchy optimization, or system\-level benchmarking.
* Knowledge of advanced topics such as DDR5, LPDDR5X, LPDDR6, memory training algorithms, RAS features, chiplet\-based memory architectures, or AI memory bandwidth optimization.


 The Team You’ll be a Part Of
   

  

 You will be part of our IP high\-performance computing applications engineering team, a group of dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology and innovation. The team focuses on helping customers integrate more capabilities into SoCs faster, working collaboratively across geographic and organizational boundaries to drive revenue growth and accelerate business closure.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
   

  

 Inclusion and Diversity
   

  

 Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Applies industry knowledge to support customers in solving issues.
   

  

 Synthesizes and combines various business and industry insights from their team, global best practices, proof points from experience/case studies with countries and/or regions, and deep industry expertise (e.g., level 200\) related to customers and their competitors to conduct forecasting and develop recommendations for managing accounts and subsidiary planning. Ensures that all levels of the organization challenge customers to consider alternatives and adapt strategies, plans, business models, and solutions to insights. Orchestrates cross\-regional teams to gather information, collaborate on performance markers, and identify potential risks in customer accounts. Oversees technical teams for driving opportunities with others, as necessary. Brings in business and industry insights to address the broader business challenges for the customer and deliver solutions.
   

  

 Differentiated Value Proposition
   

  

 Partners with a line\-of\-business leader or senior executive within a large\-scale or high\-impact customer organization to articulate how complex Microsoft technology/services will meet future business needs better than the competition and will enable the achievement of long\-term growth and success. Provides an outside\-in view around existing and emerging compete or other solutions that are also a requirement for the customer.
   

  

 Acts as the customer's Technology Mentor in established relationships with a line\-of\-business leader or senior executive within a large\-scale or high\-impact customer organization senior leaders, including technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or Business Unit leaders at the C\-level (e.g., HR, Risk, Finance leadership). Develops extended relationships beyond core customers, advises on solutions, and aligns Microsoft capabilities with customer needs. Drives market share (e.g., cloud, collaboration, AI). Leads customer business transformations through digital technologies for assigned accounts to drive business outcomes and create business value for customers by understanding customer industry and position to provide guidance and to challenge customer thinking with innovative ideas that showcase the need for change and new strategic direction, and proactively involves corporate and cross\-industry resources to drive customer transformation. Ensures line\-of\-business wins are captured (e.g., customer write\-ups) as reference for scale, and represents the face of the business during public relations events for significant business wins.
   

  

 Education and Thought Leadership
   

  

 Leads customer technology engagement by engaging and influencing technical resources of customer, partner, and Microsoft towards customer’s business transformation. Delivers regular (e.g., quarterly, monthly) industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision\-makers technical teams.
   

  

 Uses existing and new readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans for large and high\-stakes customers, and all\-up Microsoft business. Drives innovations to help customers meet capacity and capability goals, maximize reach, and impact and drive long\-term engagement and thought leadership on the Microsoft platform, and influences large customers to see and adopt the strategic value. Drives customer skilling initiatives and execution.
   

  

 Mapping and Account Planning
   

  

 Establishes best practices and standards around account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates highly complex extended account teams (e.g., spanning complex technologies, geographies, functions) and drives forecasting and tracking of the business. Owns the technical portion of the account plan and leads the customer plan delivery for large, critical, and/or strategic accounts. Captures all Account Planning input in MSX D365 Account Plan.
   

  

 Helps customer technical specialists build the message to sell Microsoft offerings to other parts of their business or end users. Creates stakeholder maps for accounts, determines, and orchestrates a coverage plan, and builds out an execution framework across multiple Rooms of the House of the customer.
   

  

 Orchestrates internal teams and local partners (inclusive of global systems integrators and consultancy partners) to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation, when appropriate.
   

  

 Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration
   

  

 Leads Account Strategy Envisioning (ASE, formerly IDTA) with the extended account team, customer, and partner to deliver the outcomes for the customer through joint envisioning, as a vehicle for Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays. Creates new Stage 1 opportunities, both billed and consumed, with technical decision maker (TDM) customer stakeholders, managing consumption pipeline with extended team to maintain velocity, and unblocking issues. Coaches peers (often as a mentor across a region or country) on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities. Defines the blueprint for opportunity initiation, and sets and shares standards and best practices for others to follow.
   

  

 Leads the customer journey into the era of AI and Industrial Metaverse by creating a targeted approach tailored to their current business requirements and positions Microsoft as a leader for the future, both for accelerating productivity as well as helping the customer create new capabilities to support their business. Leverages expertise of current technology landscape and understanding of AI and Industrial Metaverse capabilities to plot the foundational elements on the technology roadmap that need to be in place to realize value for the customer. Builds a mid\-term strategy for AI and metaverse projects as well as an immediate opportunity pipeline and orchestrates execution through the appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) and with appropriate Partners
   

  

 Creates, develops, and drives opportunities based on industry best practices, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Develops a plan, within a broader strategy, to create and qualify a set number of opportunities for product sales, solutions sales, or consumption. Leverages partners and multiple channels (e.g., social media) to create demand. Orchestrates efforts to drive MCEM lifecycle and stage progression. Leverages experience and strategic foresight to lead technical teams by driving opportunities with Specialist Team Unit (STU), Customer Success Unit (CSU), and others, as necessary. Leads efforts to reach out to key stakeholders to give customer\-driven pitches and drives the appropriate customer reach together with the account executive to generate new demand. Uses advanced technical knowledge of products to determine feasibility of technical customer requirements requests and works with core engineering teams to prepare solutions.
   

  

 Technology Strategy Formulation
   

  

 Creates mid\- and long\-term (e.g., 12 or more months) multi\-horizon technology and business roadmaps for highly prominent, challenging, and/or strategic accounts based on a deep understanding of business and technology priorities and industry landscape. Challenges and validates the strategy and plan with customer stakeholders and drives envisioning and articulates business and program changes in the roadmaps around new and groundbreaking capabilities. Leads the translation of the customer's business objectives in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays (including consumption\-heavy workloads and cloud services) to develop an effective Industry Technology Architecture to plans for and drives consumption and adoption of Microsoft cloud and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).
   

  

 Leads analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and blockers. Determines key stakeholders for driving execution on the largest and/or most complex accounts. Partners with global executives to lead overall strategy development (e.g., blocker identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end\-to\-end solutions. Leads the adoption of technologies by plotting the long\-term vision of the customer's business strategy and driving action to bring to fruition.
   

  

 Leads and ensures execution of technology strategy and digital transformation by anticipating and/or leading the resolution of technical blockers that arise during strategy planning and implementation, and driving technology adoption.
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Leverages a broad knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy to address customer's needs. Proactively coordinates with internal and external network of industry experts (e.g., Regional Experts, industry\-specific partners) to build strong knowledge of the industry and the competitive landscape. Drives and leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Leverages deep understanding of their customer to share knowledge with extended team and leverages advanced knowledge of competitors to promote customer business perspectives. Partners with others (e.g., enterprise\-channel managers) to provide sponsorship and increase impact.
   

  

 Provides Account thought leadership inclusive of information technology (IT), business strategy knowledge, and technology landscape, and shares best practices internally while providing coaching to subsidiary resources. Leverages account thought leadership in partnership with account executives to set strategy, own accountability for outcomes, and lead extended teams. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge. Creates connections and feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.
   

  

 Acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback, and challenges from the customer to internal teams (e.g., product groups, engineers) across all levels of the organization. Drives action to ensure that internal teams understand and respond to insights. Articulates the business opportunity for Microsoft based on product gaps.
   

  

 Creates security thought leadership with the customer's executives (e.g., technical decision maker \[TDM]/business decision maker \[BDM]) using the Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives and engages TDM and BDM stakeholders to position security as a business enabler and instill a security mindset in all aspects of the customer's technology landscape. Uses their understanding of the customers' technology and security needs to establish Microsoft’s security credentials and to build opportunities to improve the customer's security posture and orchestrates execution through security specialists.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required/minimum qualifications
   

  

 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 6\+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
   

  

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 12\+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
   

  

 6\+ years experience in relevant customer industry.
   

  

 6\+ years experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes.
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Associate Product Consultant
description:
**About Cvent**
 www.cvent.com
   

  

 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.
   

  

 Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.
   

  

 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
   

  

 Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection
 *.*
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “* 
*name@cvent.com* 
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* 
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud* 
*.*
**About The Role**
 Cvent Event Diagramming (formerly Social Tables) is a collaborative meeting and event diagramming platform used by planners and hotel professionals to bring successful events to life. It helps hotels and venues work with event professionals to design successful events. Hotels can show off your event space and collaborate in real\-time with planners to demonstrate how your property or venue is uniquely suited to meet their requirements.
   

  

 Hotels with Cvent Event Diagramming see a nearly 2% increase in F\&B profit per occupied room, according to STR, a hospitality data group. Event Diagramming by Cvent is the world’s most popular event planning solution — and for good reason. Join more than 5,000 venues streamlining MICE sales, marketing, and operations today.
   

  

 We have multiple Associate Product Consultant positions for graduates with 2\-5 years of work experience in our Client Services Department for the product : Event Diagramming. As our clients' primary point of contact, you will spend approximately 90% of your day assisting clients over the phone or via chat and email. There are a few other daily activities and special projects that you will be required to perform in addition to providing the best customer care possible.
   

  

* Demonstrate detailed product knowledge when assisting clients over the phone and email by answering their product questions and offering technical assistance
* Provide trainings and best practice tips to hotels and event organizers from around the world using the Cvent Supplier Network to market and sell group business
* Gather client requirements for future releases of the product
* Create and maintain all product documentation
* Document all communication with the client in Cvent’s CRM software
* Strive to meet weekly activity metrics as well as quarterly performance assessments
* Bachelor’s degree with strong academic credentials.
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
* Experience in Blended Process that involves working on Custom tasks \& Projects \- preferably travel \& hotel background.
* Strong business acumen, ethics and high integrity
* Candidate must rank within the top 20% of their present team
* Experience in working on Microsoft Excel and Word.
* Candidates should be ready to work night / late night shifts
* Must be articulate, organized, detail\-oriented and have the ability to multi\-task
* Quick learner, with a positive attitude and ability to work well within a team
* Should have 2 \- 5 years of experience with a reputed organization, BPO or call center in supporting US, UK or Australia client

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
At Kapture CX, we are looking for a
 **Customer Experience Manager** 
 in our Customer experience team.
   

  

 Kapture CX is an AI\-native, verticalized SaaS platform helping enterprises automate and execute complex customer and business workflows.
   

  

 At the core of Kapture is AgentOS — our Agentic Operating System that brings together AI agents, human intelligence, enterprise systems, and operational intelligence to execute work end\-to\-end. AgentOS enables enterprises to build, deploy, orchestrate, monitor, evaluate, and optimize AI\-powered workflows across customer support, sales, collections, claims, and other business operations.
   

  

 Today, Kapture is trusted by 1,000\+ enterprises across 18 countries, helping organizations move beyond isolated automation toward intelligent, outcome\-driven operations.
   

  

**What is this role all about?**
 As a
 **Customer Experience Manager** 
**,** 
 you become the trusted technical advisor for our clients. You ensure customers successfully onboard, integrate, and scale on Kapture’s platform while proactively solving complex technical challenges and driving long\-term value.
   

  

**Sounds interesting?**
 Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:
   

  

* You will lead client onboarding and integrations, working hands\-on with APIs, JSON payloads, and tools like Postman and cURL to ensure seamless adoption.
* You will own technical support and escalations, diagnosing issues using logs, Kafka, Grafana, Sentry, and collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to drive fast resolutions.
* You will build strong, trusted client relationships by acting as a technical advisor and advocate, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
* You will proactively identify optimization opportunities, conduct platform health checks, and recommend technical strategies to help clients maximize ROI.
* You will document issues, resolutions, and RCAs while sharing feedback and insights to influence product improvements and best practices.


 This is a
 **Delhi\-based role** 
 . We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in\-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
   

  

**What does success look like in this role?**
 You consistently deliver smooth client experiences, resolve issues before they escalate, and help customers fully leverage Kapture’s platform to achieve measurable business impact.
   

  

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**
* You have strong hands\-on experience with API integrations and system troubleshooting.
* You are comfortable working directly with enterprise clients and managing multiple priorities.
* You can collaborate effectively with engineering, product, sales, and support teams.
* You enjoy solving complex technical problems in fast\-paced environments.


**What are the most critical skills for this role?**
* You can debug issues by inspecting logs, tracing errors, and identifying root causes quickly.
* You are proficient with modern tech stacks and monitoring tools like Kafka, Grafana, and Sentry (or similar).
* You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You take ownership and think proactively about client success and platform optimization.


**You Will Have An Advantage If You**
* You have prior experience working with CRM platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot.
* You are comfortable working with SQL/NoSQL databases and understanding data flows.
* You have exposure to chatbot technologies or AI\-driven automation platforms.
* You enjoy creating clear documentation, troubleshooting guides, and RCAs.


**Why should you be interested?**
**Here’s What You Will Gain From This Role**
* An opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, clients, and business impact.
* Hands\-on exposure to large\-scale CX automation and AI\-powered platforms.
* Collaboration with highly skilled product, engineering, and customer success teams.
* Strong growth opportunities in a fast\-scaling global SaaS organization, along with competitive compensation and performance\-linked rewards.

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Aruba** 
 is an HPE Company, and a leading provider of next\-generation network access solutions for the mobile enterprise. Helping some of the largest companies in the world modernize their networks to meet the demands of a digital future, Aruba is redefining the “Intelligent Edge” – and creating new customer experiences across intelligent spaces and digital workspaces. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**Global Sales** 
 at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000\+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector \& small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**Job Family Definition**
 Serves as the overall account lead (single point of contact) for numerous, large named accounts in an assigned country, geographic territory and/or industry; understands a client’s key business and IT challenges and requirements and is focused on driving value for the client, while maximizing revenue and margin for the company. Specializes in a value or volume specialty (computers, servers, storage, services, printers) with focus on growing the base business, complex solutions, and new business opportunities. Accounts may be managed remotely. Is supported primarily by presales and inside sales resources. These jobs focus on selling to customers, typically through work that occurs outside HPE offices.
   

  

**Management Level Definition**
 Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Frequently contributes to the development of new ideas and methods. Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross\-functional initiatives. Acts as an expert providing direction and guidance to process improvements and establishing policies. Frequently represents the organization to external customers/clients. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives. May provide mentoring and guidance to lower level employees.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
***Responsibilities:***
* Builds growth opportunities using the account planning process; actively manages planning process through scheduled reviews and updates.
* Extensive time working with and leveraging external partners to deliver solution sale.
* Significant percentage of time spent directly with customer; interfaces with all levels, including highest within customer organization; highly diverse set of functions and buyers; focus in on management level.
* Develops business plan in conjunction with customer.
* Applies consultative\-selling techniques to identify and advance opportunities that result in ongoing profitable revenue growth for the company.
* Maintains high\-level of customer loyalty and builds trust and integrity, as indicated in company conducted surveys and reports.
* Responsible for achieving/managing quarterly, half yearly, annual quota and/or margin.
* Enters all opportunities in pipeline tool and updates them weekly. Recommends and Implements industry leading Pipeline management practices.
* Ability to implement margin recovery activities/strategies.
* Acts as a first interface for international accounts in collaboration with members of global business teams, and local teams.
* Identifies customer requirements, matches with company capabilities and chooses the respective company supply chain accordingly (Volume Direct or Indirect).


**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience Required:***
* University or Bachelor's degree.
* Detailed knowledge of key customer types or customers on given products.
* Viewed as expert in company; sought out by other Sales Representatives and/or first level managers for input.
* Typically 8\-12 years of experience as referenced above.
* Industry experience required.
* Experience in product specialty (computers, printers, servers, storage).


**Knowledge And Skills**
* Has good leadership skills and cross functional expertise.
* Must have good time management skills.
* Broad understanding of the customer's needs; applies standard as well as creative solutions to meet those needs; particularly considering the specific industry/market.
* Ability to coordinate multiple internal and external partners on multiple levels to deliver appropriate solution sale.
* Hi level customer management relationship building, working at management and executive level in lines of business.
* Partner organization intelligence aligned with partner management skills.
* Advanced sales negotiation, and deal closing skills.
* Identifies and effectively leads the account resources to ensure coordinated, efficient, account management, and accountability for achieving business results.

**Company:**

 **GeM portal operations, tender/bid documentation, BOQ, compliance requirements and government procurement processes**

**1\. GeM Portal Management** 



* Manage and maintain
 **Savi Vision's GeM Seller profile** 
 and related portal activities.

* Monitor portal notifications, bid enquiries, orders, amendments and other relevant updates.

**2\. GeM Bid \& Tender Management** 



* Regularly search and identify
 **relevant GeM bids, tenders and procurement opportunities** 
 for AV and system integration projects.
* Study tender documents, eligibility criteria, technical specifications, BOQ, commercial terms and submission requirements.
* Evaluate opportunities from both
 **commercial and technical compliance** 
 perspectives.
* Prepare and submit bids within the prescribed timelines.
* Coordinate with management for bid approval and commercial decisions.
* Track bid status, results, clarifications, amendments and deadlines.



**3\. OEM \& Channel Partner Coordination** 




 Since Savi Vision is a
 **System Integrator** 
 , the candidate will be required to coordinate closely with:
 


* OEMs and authorized distributors for product availability and pricing.
* OEM partners for
 **authorization letters, technical compliance, datasheets, certifications, warranty details and other bid\-related documents** 
 .
* Multiple brands to prepare suitable technical and commercial solutions as per tender requirements.
* Internal technical teams for solution design, BOQ preparation and technical compliance.



**4\. Technical \& Commercial Bid Preparation** 



* Prepare technical compliance sheets against tender specifications.
* Coordinate preparation of
 **BOQ, scope of work, product specifications and solution proposals** 
 .
* Ensure that quoted products and solutions comply with tender requirements.
* Prepare commercial quotations in coordination with the sales, procurement and management teams.
* Identify deviations or clarification points before bid submission.
* Ensure all required declarations, undertakings and supporting documents are complete and properly submitted.



**5\. Order \& Project Coordination** 



* Process and monitor
 **GeM purchase orders/contracts** 
 received by the company.
* Coordinate with sales, procurement, logistics, service and project teams for order execution.
* Monitor delivery schedules and required documentation.
* Coordinate with OEMs/distributors for timely supply of products.
* Support the team in ensuring timely
 **installation, commissioning and handover** 
 wherever applicable.
* Track order completion, acceptance, invoicing and payment\-related documentation.



**6\. Compliance \& Documentation** 



* Ensure that all GeM bids and transactions are handled in accordance with applicable GeM requirements and tender conditions.
* Maintain proper records of:
* Bids submitted
* Technical documents
* Commercial submissions
* OEM authorization documents
* Purchase orders
* Invoices and delivery documents
* Bid results and correspondence
* Maintain a systematic database of completed and ongoing bids.



**7\. Government Client \& Bid Coordination** 



* Coordinate with concerned government departments/buyers regarding GeM\-related queries, clarifications and order\-related matters.
* Follow up on submitted bids, orders, acceptance, delivery and documentation.
* Coordinate internally to ensure timely responses to buyer queries and requests.



**8\. Reporting** 



* Prepare regular
 **GeM bid and tender status reports** 
 for management.
* Maintain reports covering:
* Opportunities identified
* Bids submitted
* Bids under evaluation
* Orders received
* Bid outcomes
* Upcoming deadlines
* Provide management with timely updates on important GeM opportunities.



**Key Requirements** 




**Education:** 




 Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field.
 



**Experience:** 




 2–4 years of experience handling
 **GeM portal operations, government tenders or e\-procurement** 
 , preferably in AV, IT, digital signage, electronics, system integration or a related industry.
 



**Required Skills** 



* Strong hands\-on knowledge of
 **GeM Seller Portal** 
 .
* Good understanding of GeM bids, tenders and bid submission procedures.
* Experience in preparing
 **technical compliance sheets and commercial bids** 
 .
* Ability to understand product specifications, BOQ and tender documents.
* Strong coordination skills with
 **OEMs, distributors, internal technical teams and management** 
 .
* Good knowledge of MS
 **Excel, Word and PowerPoint** 
 .
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines simultaneously.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.



**Preferred Experience** 




 Candidates with experience in
 **AV System Integration, digital signage, professional displays, video conferencing, interactive displays, audio systems, automation or related technology solutions** 
 will be preferred.
 



 Experience in dealing with
 **multiple OEM brands rather than a single manufacturer's product portfolio** 
 will be an added advantage.
 



**Key Performance Areas (KPIs)** 



* Number of relevant GeM opportunities identified.
* Timely and accurate bid submissions.
* Compliance with tender requirements.
* Coordination with OEMs/channel partners for required documentation.
* Order conversion and successful execution.
* Timely response to buyer queries and amendments.
* Accuracy of GeM documentation and records.
* Timely submission of reports to management.



**Ideal Candidate** 




 The ideal candidate should be
 **organized, responsible, commercially aware and highly attentive to detail** 
 . The person should be comfortable working with tender documents, coordinating with multiple OEMs and internal departments, and managing several GeM opportunities simultaneously.
 



 A candidate who understands the difference between
 **OEM supply and system integration** 
 and can build complete multi\-brand AV solutions against government tender requirements would be particularly suitable for this role.

title: Category Manager – Partnerships & Distribution
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 We're building one of India's most interesting marketing teams in the mobility space, and we need someone who can own a portfolio of channels the way a brand manager owns a category: with commercial instinct, cross\-functional pull, and a genuine drive to grow.
   

  

 This isn't a coordination role \-you will own Brand partnerships, offline distribution, and OTA set strategy, run execution, and be accountable for outcomes. You'll work directly with the India Leadership and also operate as a key node between local teams and global stakeholders.
   

  

 If you've grown up in FMCG or a fast\-scaling startup and know what it means to own a channel from the ground up, this is the job.
   

  

**About The Role**
* You think about the Flix brand in India with both a short and long term lens. Contributing to how the brand shows up across your channels today while helping shape the positioning and perception we want to build over the next 3 to 5 years
* Build and manage Flix's B2B and brand partnership pipeline in India. Identifying prospects, closing deals, onboarding partners, and tracking commercial contribution to load
* Be the external face of Flix on OTA platforms, owning platform relationships, content quality, listing health, and commercial terms across all major OTA partners in India
* Manage the offline sales network. Travel agencies, ticket shops, and kiosks — from acquisition through to partner enablement, training, and performance management
* You collaborate across marketing, performance, CRM, and product to prevent channel strategies from running in silos and to unlock shared growth levers
* Identify and pursue new distribution and partnership opportunities in the Indian market, bringing commercial rigour to everything from a first pitch to a signed deal
* You liaise with HQ and global teams to keep local channel strategies aligned with Flix's broader commercial and brand direction
* You act as the primary external point of contact for partners across B2B, offline, and OTA, representing Flix with authority


**About You**
* 3 to 5 years in brand management, category management, or channel marketing, ideally in D2C, or a high\-growth startup
* You've owned marketing spends or a channel target before, not just reported into one.
* Comfortable managing a wide portfolio without losing depth on what matters most.
* Strong negotiator and relationship builder. You can hold a room with a internal teams, external partner and on ground sales agents in the same day.
* Sharp with numbers, fast with decisions, and honest about what's working


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Presales head - India (HCM Functional presales)
description:
Darwinbox is competing for the most complex enterprise HCM transformations in the market and the conversation is changing. As we move toward an AI\-native HCM future and launch Cortex, our AI product, we need a Presales leader who can connect business problems, enterprise transformation, product capability, and commercial value into a story CXOs cannot ignore
   

  

 We’re not looking for someone who simply presents the product.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who can shape the customer's thinking before they shape the solution.
   

  

 Your role as India presales head is to make Darwinbox impossible to ignore in the enterprise HCM \+ AI conversation \- shaping deals early, elevating the quality of customer conversations, increasing win rates, and building a presales organization that can scale with the business.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
* You will lead India Presales and a team of \~10\-15, partnering closely with Sales and senior leaders to shape strategic enterprise and mid\-market deals. You will be the person in the room who can understand what a business is trying to change, challenge the way it is thinking about the problem, and translate that into a compelling Darwinbox solution and business case.
* This is equal parts transformation advisor, deal strategist, and presales leader with the opportunity to influence how Darwinbox takes its next generation of HCM and AI capabilities to market.


**What Work Looks Like**
* Shape the deal before the demo. Partner with Sales from the earliest conversations to understand the account, shape the buying journey, qualify opportunities, and build a differentiated solution and value story.
* Be a CXO\-level transformation advisor. Engage business leaders across functions, understand their strategic priorities, and connect HCM transformation to measurable business outcomes.
* Make complexity simple. Translate complex enterprise requirements into clear solution narratives, compelling demonstrations, POCs, and transformation roadmaps.
* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10\-15\-member organization; build capability and future leaders.
* Create a winning market motion. Define solution\-led GTM strategies for new markets and product lines, strengthen competitive positioning, and identify what will move enterprise buyers.
* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.
* Build AI\-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI\-native.
* Drive initiatives. Participate and lead organizations initiatives as they come up from time to time


**Role expectations**
* Think beyond the RFP. Help customers rethink the problem before responding to the requirement.
* Own the commercial outcome. Balance customer value, solution quality, deal strategy, and presales investment to improve revenue, win rates, and sales velocity.

description:
**Brand Solutions Manager/ Brand Partnerships Manager**

**Company:** 

 Creators Yug™
 




**Location:** 

 Saket, New Delhi
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-Time
 




**Experience:** 

 1\-2 Years
 




**Work Mode:** 

 On Site
 




  




**About Creators Yug™** 


 Creators Yug™ is an influencer marketing and talent management company helping brands build meaningful connections with audiences through creators across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and other platforms.
 




  




**About the Role**


 We are looking for a
 
**Brand Solutions Manager / Brand Partnerships Manager** 

 who can independently drive business development, build strong brand relationships, understand client requirements and convert them into impactful influencer marketing solutions.
 





 This is not a traditional sales or follow\-up role. We are looking for someone who can
 
**own the entire brand partnership cycle** 

 — from identifying opportunities and pitching to negotiation, closure and relationship management.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities**
* Identify and build relationships with
 
**brand managers, marketing heads, growth teams and agencies** 

 .
* Generate new business opportunities through outbound outreach, networking, referrals and existing relationships.
* Understand brand objectives and create relevant
 
**influencer marketing solutions and campaign strategies** 

 .
* Prepare and present proposals, pitches, creator recommendations and commercials.
* Lead client conversations, negotiations and commercial discussions.
* Manage the complete sales cycle from
 
**lead generation → discovery → proposal → negotiation → closure → handover** 

 .
* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients and identify opportunities for repeat business and upselling.
* Coordinate with the internal Operations and Creator teams to ensure smooth campaign handover.
* Maintain accurate sales pipelines, follow\-ups and revenue projections.
* Track industry trends, brand campaigns and emerging opportunities.
* Take ownership of monthly and quarterly business targets.



  




**Ownership \& Decision\-Making** 

  






 At Creators Yug™, we believe in giving people ownership.
 





 We are looking for someone who can:
 




**See → Understand → Strategize → Pitch → Close → Own.** 





 You should be able to manage your business pipeline independently without requiring the Founder for every conversation or decision.
 





 If a client has a challenge, you should be able to understand the requirement and develop a solution.
 





 If a deal is stuck, you should be able to identify the reason and find a way forward.
 




**Your responsibility is not just to generate leads — it is to build business.** 




  




**What We're Looking For**
* 1\-2 years of experience in
 
**B2B sales, brand partnerships, influencer marketing, digital marketing or media sales** 

 .
* Strong understanding of the Indian brand and digital marketing ecosystem.
* Existing relationships with brands/agencies will be an advantage.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
* Ability to understand client requirements and create solutions.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Comfortable working with revenue targets.
* Proactive, accountable and solution\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work independently and manage the complete sales cycle.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets / Excel and presentation tools.



  




**Key KPIs** 

  






 Performance will primarily be measured through:
 



* New business generated.
* Monthly and quarterly revenue.
* Qualified leads generated.
* Conversion and closure rate.
* Average deal value.
* Repeat business from existing clients.
* Client relationship quality.
* Sales pipeline health and accuracy.
* Timely follow\-ups and proposal submissions.
* Ability to independently manage and close opportunities.


**Growth Opportunity**


 High\-performing team members can grow into:
 




**Brand Partnerships Manager → Senior Manager → Business Development Lead → Head of Brand Partnerships → Business/Revenue Leadership** 





 We want people who don't just want to
 
**sell campaigns** 

 , but want to help build the
 
**business and the brand partnerships function at Creators Yug™** 

 .
 




  




**Who Should Apply?** 

  






 If you are someone who:
 



* Loves talking to brands.
* Enjoys building relationships.
* Can understand a business problem and create a solution.
* Is confident in negotiations.
* Takes ownership of targets.
* Doesn't wait for instructions.
* Wants to build something rather than simply follow a process.



  





**We'd love to hear from you.** 




**Don't just bring us leads.** 




**Bring us opportunities, relationships and business.** 




**Creators Yug™ — Building a future where creators drive commerce at scale.** 




  





**Share your CV at hr@creatorsyug.com**

 **Sustainable Value Chain** 
**,** 
 where you will get an opportunity to advise and work with our key global clients, driving end\-to\-end transformative strategic value and business growth. We also work with global organizations such as the World Economic Forum, the United Nations Global Compact and World Business Council for Sustainable Development. As a part of this high performing team, these are some of the areas you will consult clients on:
   

  

* Resilient Supply Chain Strategy: Work closely with clients to assess vulnerabilities across their value chains and co\-develop end\-to\-end resilience and sustainability strategies tailored to their business context.
* Sustainable Value Creation: Help clients build supply chain operating models that are economically efficient while embedding environmental and social responsibility across procurement, operations, and logistics.
* Supply Chain Transformation Roadmaps: Develop implementation road maps for resilient and sustainable supply chains, leveraging data\-driven insights across themes such as circular economy, supply chain decarbonization, traceability, and responsible sourcing.
* Industry Partner Alliances: Work with notable organizations like UN, WEF, FICCI and prominent business leaders to shape sustainable business agendas.
* Supply Chain Decarbonization: Develop a deep understanding of Scope 3 emissions, low\-carbon logistics, and supplier decarbonization strategies, and drive meaningful conversations around net zero transition across value chains.
* Circular \& Traceable Supply Chains: Design go\-to\-market and entry strategies for clients embedding circularity, traceability, and regulatory compliance (EUDR, CSDDD, DPP) into their supply chain and product strategies.
* Technology\-Enabled Supply Chains: Work with clients to assess the digital maturity and environmental footprint of their supply chain technology landscape and recommend strategies leveraging AI, platforms, and data to drive efficiency and sustainability


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Support Supply Chain Sustainability \& Resilience Projects Conduct research, analysis, and problem\-solving to help clients design resilient and sustainable supply chain strategies across procurement, operations, and logistics.
* Analyse Data \& Develop Insights Leverage qualitative and quantitative data to identify trends, assess risks, evaluate sustainability performance, and generate actionable recommendations for clients.
* Develop Client\-Ready Deliverables Create high\-quality presentations, reports, business cases, and implementation roadmaps that effectively communicate strategic recommendations and transformation plans.
* Drive Sustainability Transformation Initiatives Assist in projects focused on supply chain decarbonization, circular economy, traceability, responsible sourcing, and ESG\-related value chain transformations.
* Collaborate with Cross\-Functional Stakeholders Work closely with global client teams, industry experts, technology partners, and internal stakeholders to support project delivery and stakeholder management activities.
* Leverage Digital, AI \& Sustainability Technologies Assess supply chain technologies, utilize AI/GenAI\-enabled tools for analysis and reporting, and recommend digital solutions that improve efficiency, transparency, resilience, and sustainability outcomes


**Professional \& Technical Skills:**
* Strategic \& Consulting Mindset \- Ability to work on complex client problems and recommend innovative approaches and solutions
* Skillset to analyze large amounts of qualitative and quantitative data to draw insights and trends
* Structured problem solving and strong analytical skills
* Ability to present the recommendations in a compelling narrative through client ready deliverables.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to leverage that to for project delivery and stakeholder management
* Building relationships with potential and existing clients and being responsible for business development in assigned areas
* Potential to work with diverse teams and to be able to foster learning, exchange and innovation
* Grasp of MS power point, Excel and Word is important. Other tools like Power BI and Tableau are a plus
* Familiarity with AI and GenAI tools and their application in supply chain and sustainability contexts, including data analysis, report generation, and scenario modelling


**Additional Information:**
 We are hiring across multiple roles! Experience in one or more categories listed below will be preferred.
   

  

**AREA 1: RISK \& RESILIENCE**
* Experience in Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) \- including supplier risk assessments, risk scoring frameworks, and sustainability\-linked due diligence
* Hands\-on experience with N\-tier visibility tools and scenario simulation
* Ability to design and implement supplier risk monitoring frameworks, including financial, operational, and ESG\-linked risk indicators
* Experience conducting supply chain risk mapping — identifying single points of failure, geographic concentration risks, and supplier dependency analysis
* Ability to develop risk mitigation roadmaps and resilience strategies that integrate sustainability considerations across supply chains
* Experience working with risk and resilience platforms such as Osapiens, Interos, or ProcessUnity


**OR**
**AREA 2: TRACEABILITY**
* Strong understanding of traceability regulations and standards including EUDR, CSDDD, PPWR, Digital Product Passport (DPP), and GS1 standards
* Experience designing and implementing traceability and transparency solutions across complex, multi\-tier supply chains
* Familiarity with Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), product\-level carbon footprint methodologies, and Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) approaches
* Knowledge of regulatory landscape including extended producer responsibility (EPR), waste management regulations, and product compliance frameworks (EU Taxonomy, CBAM)
* Experience with ESG data and technology architecture for traceability use cases
* Ability to gather business requirements, identify platform fits and gaps, and develop functional specifications for traceability and sustainability reporting use cases


**OR**
**AREA 3: CIRCULAR SUPPLY CHAINS**
* Strong experience working on circular economy projects across thematic areas such as plastic packaging, e\-waste, textiles
* Experience designing circular transformation strategies across supply chains — including reverse logistics, take\-back model design, and material flow analysis
* Knowledge of technology enablement and service plays that support circularity — including digital platforms (e.g. Agora) for tracking material flows and closed\-loop systems
* Understanding of circular strategy and business model design, including circular operating model design and sustainable product portfolio steering
* Proven experience with P\&L modelling, business model innovation, and go\-to\-market strategy in the context of circular product and service innovation
* Experience with supplier assessments and supplier development using tools such as Eco Vadis, with a focus on circular economy compliance


**OR**
**AREA 4: SUPPLY CHAIN DECARBONIZATION**
* Strong experience in supplier decarbonization managed programs — including supplier engagement \& onboarding, emissions baselining, and decarbonization roadmap development
* Experience with science\-based target setting (SBTi) and delivering science\-based targets as a service
* Deep understanding of Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions accounting, carbon neutrality strategies, and low\-carbon energy transition across key geographies (US, EU, India, Australia)
* Strong experience working on clean energy projects including onsite/offsite Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs), and carbon offsets
* Experience with ESG reporting frameworks and sustainability data platforms (SAP, Workiva, Enablon, Oracle, MSM) for carbon and climate disclosure use cases
* Understanding of ESG Intelligence capabilities including gap assessment vs ESG frameworks, GenAI\-powered sustainability report generation, and end\-to\-end ESG platform implementation

description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 Your specific project activities include performing diagnostics and customizing and implementing our analytical tools across the clients’ organization.
   

  

 You’ll work in teams playing an active role in the client engagement. You will use a tech\-enabled approach to tackle client challenges related to end\-to\-end supply chain planning from demand forecasting and inventory management to S\&OP, production planning and scheduling, and order management.
   

  

 The increasing complexity of integrated tactical and operational systems, combined with an explosion of data, makes these topics both top\-of\-mind and deeply challenging for many clients. Capitalizing upon your analytics and data science background, you will fortify and enhance Manufacturing and Supply Chain's (MSC’s) digital tools to customize the output to precise client situations. Most importantly, you will develop insights and implement solutions which produce tangible and lasting impact on our clients’ operational performance.
   

  

 Your client’s projects will range from quick diagnostics up to multi\-month digital implementations. In between studies, you will bring your learnings back to our internal team to help refine digital modules and ideate powerful new capabilities.
   

  

 Through your work, you’ll have opportunities to present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. You’ll gain new skills and build on the strengths you bring to the firm.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Master’s degree in an analytics/data centric area such as supply chain management, mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science, or industrial engineering
* 1\+ years of operations research, analytics and/or data science work in industry with a focus on supply chain topics (internships may count as work experience)
* Outstanding record of academic achievement
* Knowledge of analytical concepts relevant for supply chain optimization, such as statistics, time\-series analyses, and classical operations research methods, in particular mathematical programming (esp. mixed\-integer linear programming) and corresponding IT tools (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, AIMMs), and methods from applied statistics (esp. time series forecasting) and stochastic modelling and optimization (e.g., Markov Decision Processes)
* Understanding of IT (e.g. databases and data structures) and demonstrated knowledge of at least one standard programming language (e.g. Python, C\+\+, Java)
* Good understanding of supply chain concepts such as supply chain strategy, production management, scheduling, network design, inventory, and logistics
* Demonstrated strong conceptual and analytical skills; success in working on high impact cross\-functional teams; strong decision making and problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrated aptitude for analytics and data science, plus appropriate educational and on\-the\-job training
* Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities, and an entrepreneurial bent
* Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 60%, occasionally internationally
* Language fluency skills to communicate complex ideas effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English

 PMP / Prince2 / SAFe / ITIL (preferred)
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Delivery Manager to lead end\-to\-end delivery of large\-scale, complex programs within Accenture's Utilities practice in India. The role sits at the intersection of conventional power, renewable energy, and enterprise technology — requiring equal comfort with domain depth and program execution rigour. The ideal candidate can own client relationships, govern multi\-workstream engagements, and drive outcomes across consulting, digital, and transformation mandates in the utilities sector.
   

  

**Core Delivery Responsibilities**

* Ensure delivery quality through structured QA, testing governance, and milestone sign\-offs
* Lead resource planning, capacity management, and vendor / subcontractor oversight
* Own financials — revenue recognition, margin management, billing milestones, and forecasting
* Navigate change management, contractual amendments, and SOW expansions
* Act as the primary escalation point for delivery risks and client concerns


**DOMAIN EXPERTISE – UTILITIES**
**Conventional Power**
* Strong understanding of thermal, hydro, nuclear, and gas\-based generation assets
* Familiarity with transmission and distribution (T\&D) infrastructure, grid operations, and load dispatch
* Knowledge of utility operations — generation scheduling, outage management, and asset lifecycle
* Experience with DISCOM / TRANSCO / GENCO operating models and regulatory frameworks
* Understanding of CERC / SERC regulations, tariff orders, and state utility governance


**Renewable Energy**
* Working knowledge of utility\-scale solar PV, wind (onshore/offshore), hybrid, and BESS projects
* Exposure to green hydrogen, corporate PPAs, open access, and captive power models
* Familiarity with SECI auctions, RPO compliance, ISTS policies, and RE project structuring
* Understanding of carbon markets, RECs, and energy transition frameworks
* Awareness of decarbonization roadmaps, net\-zero strategies, and ESG reporting in the utility context


**Energy Markets \& Commercial**
* Understanding of Indian electricity markets — DAM, TAM, G\-DAM, bilateral contracts, and banking
* Familiarity with RE project economics, project finance fundamentals, and PPA structures
* Exposure to energy procurement strategies for large C\&I consumers and utilities


**TECHNOLOGY \& DIGITAL DELIVERY**
**Core Technology Domains**
* OT/IT convergence – SCADA, EMS/DMS, ADMS, GIS, and asset management systems (EAM)
* Smart metering – AMI/AMR deployments, MDM platforms, meter data analytics
* Grid modernisation – smart grid programs, distribution automation, demand response
* Digital twin and asset performance management (APM) platforms


**Data, AI \& Analytics**
* Familiarity with AI/ML use cases in utilities – energy forecasting, predictive maintenance, outage analytics
* Exposure to IoT\-enabled monitoring platforms for generation and network assets


**Cloud \& Integration**
* Delivery experience on cloud platforms – Azure, AWS, or Oracle in a utility/energy context
* Understanding of integration architecture – APIs, middleware, legacy modernization
* Familiarity with cybersecurity and data governance considerations in OT environments


**CLIENT \& STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT**
* Proven ability to manage senior client relationships – CXOs, Directors, and Programme Sponsors
* Experience engaging utility regulators, government bodies, and policy stakeholders
* Ability to navigate complex multi\-stakeholder environments across client, vendor, and internal teams
* Strong commercial acumen — protecting Accenture's position while growing client relationships
* Track record of identifying and converting scope expansion, add\-on work, and new opportunities


**PEOPLE \& PRACTICE DEVELOPMENT**
* Drive talent development, performance management, and career planning within the team
* Contribute to practice\-building initiatives — assets, accelerators, PoVs, and go\-to\-market
* Participate in proposals, RFP responses, and solution presentations for new pursuits


*Confidential – Accenture Utilities Practice \| For Internal Recruitment Use Only*

**Band:** 
 Senior Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Anywhere In India
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full Time/Work from Office
 



**Function:** 
 Pre\-Sales, RFP Response and Solution Support
 



  





**Mandatory Requirement:** 
 Prior experience or strong domain exposure in
 **Insurance** 
 is mandatory.
 



**Property \& Casualty experience is preferred; Life, Annuities, Retirement or Pensions exposure is desirable.** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an entry\-level Pre\-Sales Consultant at Senior Manager band to support Insurance BPS pursuits across RFP responses, solution documentation, RLS creation, proposal coordination and stakeholder follow\-up. The role will work closely with senior solution leaders and cross\-functional teams to produce high\-quality, timely and consistent pursuit deliverables.
 **Insurance domain experience or meaningful Insurance process exposure is mandatory for this role.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Support the preparation of RFP, RFI and due diligence responses by collating inputs, drafting content, maintaining response trackers and ensuring timely completion of assigned sections.
* Create and maintain RLS / Role Labour Schedule inputs, resource assumptions and workforce requirement templates in coordination with solution, delivery and finance stakeholders.
* Assist in solution documentation including operating model narratives, process scope, location strategy, transition approach, governance model, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
* Coordinate with Finance and pricing teams to gather cost inputs, FTE assumptions, productivity levers, pyramid mix inputs and commercial dependencies required for proposal completion.
* Work with SMU, Technology, SRM, BITS, Quality, Risk, Security, Compliance and Transformation Office teams to collect validated inputs and ensure proposal responses are complete and aligned.
* Maintain bid calendars, action trackers, version control, submission checklists, open items logs and stakeholder follow\-up notes for active pursuits.
* Support the creation of client presentation materials, solution summaries, case study inputs, transformation intervention lists and executive proposal sections.
* Research Insurance industry processes, client pain points, solution benchmarks and Wipro capability content to strengthen response quality and relevance.
* Ensure standard templates, reusable content, credentials, assumptions and compliance responses are kept up to date for future pursuits.
* Participate in internal review meetings, capture actions, follow through on pending items and support leadership with concise status updates.



  





**Required Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree is required. MBA, Insurance, Finance, Operations or Business\-related qualification is preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience in Insurance operations, BPS/BPO, consulting support, proposal support, bid management, solution support, business analysis or pre\-sales support.
* Mandatory: Insurance domain exposure through operations, process knowledge, consulting, pre\-sales, proposal support, transition support or business analysis. Candidates without Insurance exposure should not be shortlisted.
* Exposure to Property \& Casualty Insurance is preferred. Life Insurance, Annuities, Retirement, Pensions, Claims, Policy Administration, Underwriting Support or Customer Service exposure will be an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of RFP response structure, proposal lifecycle, solution components, operating model build\-up, staffing assumptions and transition dependencies.
* Ability to work with data, templates, Excel trackers, PowerPoint content and Word\-based proposal documents with high attention to detail.



  





**Functional Skills** 



* Strong written communication skills with ability to draft clear, professional and client\-ready responses.
* Good coordination and follow\-up discipline across multiple stakeholders and workstreams.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint, Word and Excel for proposal development, trackers, RLS inputs and management reporting.
* Ability to summarize inputs, identify gaps, raise risks early and maintain organized documentation during tight timelines.
* Understanding of business process outsourcing concepts such as FTE modelling, productivity, transition, governance, quality, compliance and service delivery metrics.
* Comfort working in a global environment with cross\-functional teams across sales, solutioning, delivery, finance, technology and transformation.



  





**Behavioral Expectations** 



* High ownership mindset, responsiveness and willingness to learn in a fast\-paced bid environment.
* Strong attention to detail, document hygiene and version\-control discipline.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, follow instructions accurately and meet internal deadlines.
* Professional communication style with the confidence to follow up with senior stakeholders for inputs and clarifications.
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively as part of a pursuit team.
* Curiosity to build Insurance domain depth and develop into a stronger pre\-sales and solutioning professional over time.



  





**Key Success Measures** 



* Timely completion of assigned RFP/RFI response sections and pursuit support activities.
* Accuracy and completeness of RLS inputs, trackers, assumptions and documentation.
* Quality of coordination across Finance, SMU, Technology, SRM, BITS, Quality, Risk, Compliance and Transformation teams.
