title: Business Technology Solutions Consultant
description:
**ZS** 
 is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
 **bringing together data, science, technology** 
 and
 **human ingenuity** 
 to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side\-by\-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life\-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
 **client\-first mentality** 
 to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life\-changing impact to ZS.
   

  

**Business Technology Solutions Consultant**
 We are seeking an experienced and client\-ready Data Engineer Consultant with 5–7 years of professional experience to join our Business Technology Solutions – Supply Chain \& Manufacturing team. The successful candidate will bring deep technical expertise in cloud data platforms, Python, and SQL, combined with a proven ability to lead technical delivery engagements end\-to\-end. In this role, you will translate business requirements into robust solution designs and architectures, lead engineering teams through implementation, and serve as the senior technical voice in client engagements. You will be expected to mentor a team of data engineers / cross\-functional analysts, enforce best practices across design, code, and testing, and consistently deliver high\-quality outcomes as per planned project timelines.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Translate complex business requirements into actionable solution designs and technical architectures, owning the end\-to\-end solution from discovery through UAT and production launches.
* Lead one or more concurrent projects as the primary technical delivery owner, working in close partnership with the project manager on planning, staffing, risk identification, and milestone management.
* Align cross\-functional teams — including business analysts, architects, validation / testing, and engineering — on the right technology stack and solution approach for each engagement.
* Own the quality and completeness of all key project deliverables: business case, solution vision and design documentation, technical architecture, test cases, deployment plans, and operations strategy.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for client stakeholders — leading design reviews, status updates, brainstorming sessions, and innovation discussions.
* Conduct regular design, code, and testing reviews to enforce best practices and ensure all implementations meet quality, performance, and maintainability standards.
* Mentor and develop a team of associate consultants and engineers, setting technical direction, reviewing output, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of best\-in\-class coding practices, data quality frameworks, and validation approaches to ensure reliable and impactful business insights.
* Build and deliver cloud\-based data engineering solutions including ETL/ELT pipelines, serverless architectures, real\-time and batch analytics, and data lake/warehouse implementations.
* Partner with senior leadership on business development activities, POV development, and building firm intellectual capital on emerging technologies and business solution areas.
* Lead structured and unstructured problem\-solving exercises to design and optimize complex, high\-performance solutions.
* Ensure all SDLC documentation is accurate, complete, and supports both the delivery team and client governance requirements.


**What you’ll bring:**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
* 5\-7 years of hands\-on experience as a data engineer, with at least 2 years in a client\-facing consulting or professional services environment.
* Deep expertise in cloud data platforms – like AWS (EMR, Glue, S3, Athena, Redshift, LakeFormation, Managed Airflow, SageMaker), Azure (ADF, Synapse, ADLS), Databricks, Snowflake.
* Strong experience with data modeling, data warehousing concepts, and distributed computing frameworks (Spark/PySpark).
* Strong design and programming proficiency in Python and SQL; ability to design solutions, perform in depth data analysis and write production\-grade code and perform rigorous code reviews.
* Proven track record designing and delivering end\-to\-end data engineering solutions at scale, including complex ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.
* Experience leading technical delivery teams – managing project planning, effort estimation, work distribution, and progress tracking in an SDLC or Agile delivery setup.
* Demonstrated ability to interact directly with senior to mid\-senior client stakeholders, present technical concepts clearly, and manage engagement delivery expectations.
* Working knowledge of AI tools and platforms is preferred (e.g., use of AI\-assisted development, LLM\-based tooling, model integration into data pipelines).
* Experience in supply chain or manufacturing domain is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on AI engineering or agentic development experience (LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, AI agents) is a significant differentiator and will be considered a strong plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills – able to tailor messaging from engineering\-level detail to business understandable / executive summaries.
* Ability to distill complex technical architectures into clear frameworks, diagrams, and presentations for diverse audiences.
* Strong coaching, mentorship, and team\-building capabilities; comfortable developing mid\-level engineers.
* Comfortable operating in a global, matrixed team environment across time zones.
* Knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) and ontologies (RDF\-based) is a plus.
* We operate in a hybrid setup and candidate’s in\-office presence would be required based on the same. Travel to client sites may also be required.
* Capable of managing a virtual global team for the timely delivery of multiple projects
* Experienced in analyzing and troubleshooting interactions between databases, operating systems, and applications
* Travel to global offices as required to collaborate with clients and internal project teams
* Fluency in English
* Client\-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem\-solving approach


**How you’ll grow:**
* Cross\-functional skills development \& custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s\-curves, individual contribution and role expansions


**Perks \& Benefits:**
 At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations \| Where we work \| ZS.
   

  

**Hybrid working model:**
 We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on\-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face\-to\-face connections.
   

  

**Travel:**
 Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client\-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
   

  

**Considering applying?**
 At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.
   

  

 If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.
   

  

 To complete your application:
   

  

 Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on\-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.
   

  

 NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.
   

  

 Find Out More At:
   

  

 www.zs.com

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Sr Professional Services Consultant (PSC)
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Your Career As a Professional Services Consultant, you will be a pivotal technical expert, spearheading the successful deployment and initial configuration of our Prisma Access Browser (PAB) solution for customers. This is a highly impactful, hands\-on role where you will directly translate customer security requirements into a fully operational and optimized cloud\-delivered browser security solution. Working closely with customers, solution consultants, and project managers, you will implement PAB according to best practices and customer\-specific needs. Beyond deployment, you will be a proactive driver, navigating complex environments, anticipating roadblocks, and accelerating our customers' journey to a Zero Trust architecture. You will solidify customer partnerships with Palo Alto Networks by ensuring they successfully adopt and maximize the value of PAB. If you thrive on technical challenges, leading complex deployments, and being the face of strategic, results\-driven implementation, this is your next career move. Your Impact Proactively Drive Technical Deployment: Execute the complete technical lifecycle of PAB implementation, including secure tenant setup and complex Identity Provider (IdP) integrations. Take ownership of the deployment timeline, proactively managing and overcoming any customer hesitations or delays to ensure rapid time\-to\-value Translate Strategy to Security Policy: Convert customer business and security designs into practical, effective PAB configurations, focusing on access controls, data loss prevention (DLP) rules, and web security policies Drive Adoption: Guide customers through the secure and large\-scale deployment of the PAB extension/client to end\-user devices using various enterprise deployment methods (e.g., GPO, MDM) Be a Proactive Technical Advisor: Serve as the go\-to expert for PAB best practices, advanced feature utilization, and performance tuning, actively monitoring environments to pre\-emptively identify, recommend, and resolve potential issues or areas for security posture improvement Resolve Complex Escalations: Act as the primary technical escalation point, performing deep\-dive root cause analysis and coordinating across Support, Engineering, and Product teams for timely resolution Document and Transfer Knowledge: Create high\-quality, customer\-specific "as\-built" documentation and deliver comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer to customer administrators Advocate for the Customer: Capture and translate valuable field feedback into actionable feature requests, serving as a critical internal voice for product improvement and development Maintain expert\-level understanding of Prisma Access Browser: Stay updated on latest product releases, security trends, and industry best practices. Actively participate in relevant training and certification programs to maintain technical proficiency
   

  

**Qualifications (Additional Job Description)**
 Your Experience 8\+ years of experience required in a hands\-on, technical, customer\-facing role such as Professional Services Consultant, Technical Account Manager, or Senior Sales Engineer Proven track record of proactive engagement; the ability to take initiative to push customers toward successful deployment, manage project risks, and navigate organizational challenges or pushback to maintain project velocity Expert\-level knowledge of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S) and enterprise security principles (Zero Trust, SASE, Firewall, Proxy, VPN) Demonstrated ability to independently lead and execute complex technical projects in customer environments, driving deployment to successful completion Advanced analytical and troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving technical issues (Root Cause Analysis) Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to convey complex security topics to diverse technical and non\-technical stakeholders Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and authentication protocols, specifically integrating solutions with IdPs like Azure AD or Okta using SAML 2\.0 Familiarity with cloud and SaaS security architecture and the challenges associated with securing modern applications and browsers Knowledge of Prisma Access deployment, architecture, and traffic flows These skills are desired and will be prioritized, accelerating time\-to\-value in the role: Basic knowledge of enterprise tools for large\-scale device deployment (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, SCCM) Industry certifications such as Palo Alto Networks (PCNSA, PCNSE), CISSP, or cloud\-specific security certifications Basic scripting ability (e.g., PowerShell, Python) for automation or data manipulation
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com .
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Field Partnerships Manager, Delhi NCR
description:
**Company Description** 
 Me100 is redefining where health begins in India by focusing on early signals of disease long before symptoms appear. The company offers advanced testing beyond standard full body checkups, using over 100 biomarkers across more than 13 body systems. Me100 combines family history, medical context, and lifestyle data into a single connected picture, reviewed by biomedical experts, with two in\-depth readings each year to track changes in the body. Individuals receive insights on biological age versus calendar age, along with a personalized action plan after each reading. At\-home sample collection is enabled through leading NABL\-accredited labs across 200\+ cities, supporting people to think long\-term about their health and well\-being.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Field Partnerships Manager, Delhi NCR is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi. This role is responsible for identifying, onboarding, and nurturing partnerships with clinics, wellness centers, corporates, and other health ecosystem stakeholders in the Delhi NCR region. The manager will conduct regular field visits, present Me100’s offerings, negotiate terms, and ensure smooth execution of partnership agreements. Day\-to\-day activities include managing partner relationships, tracking performance metrics, coordinating with internal teams for operations and marketing support, and resolving partner issues promptly. The role also involves gathering market insights, contributing to local go\-to\-market strategies, and representing Me100 at events and meetings to strengthen brand presence.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Partnerships and Strategic Partnerships skills to identify, build, and grow high\-impact relationships.
* Account Management and Communication skills to maintain partner satisfaction and manage ongoing collaboration.
* Analytical Skills to interpret data, assess partnership performance, and inform decisions.
* Experience in field sales, business development, or ecosystem partnerships, ideally in health, wellness, or related sectors.
* Ability to work on\-site across the Delhi NCR region, with flexibility to travel for meetings and events.
* Comfort using CRM tools and basic productivity software to track activities and outcomes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Management, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Self\-driven, organized, and able to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment.

**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance, create value and accelerate results. Founded in 1983, A\&M is recognized for its entrepreneurial, action\-oriented culture and hands\-on approach to client problems. Its professionals work as independent thinkers and operators, combining practical execution with deep advisory expertise across industries and geographies. A\&M’s Global Capability Center in India, established in 2023, partners with business units and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC to deliver end\-to\-end client work, not only back\-office support. The rapidly growing center brings together consulting and industry professionals across Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources and Financial Services. Guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward and Inclusive Diversity, A\&M focuses on leadership, action and results while creating measurable value for clients and stakeholders.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in GDN Advisory, you will lead consulting workstreams that help organizations design, launch and optimize Global Business Services and Global Capability Center models. You will translate strategic priorities into practical operating models, business cases, transition plans and transformation roadmaps that improve service quality, efficiency and enterprise value. Working with A\&M leaders, client executives and cross\-functional teams, you will own analysis, solution design and client\-ready deliverables across global markets and industries. The role combines structured problem solving with hands\-on implementation, requiring confidence in senior stakeholder discussions and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. You will also strengthen the practice through mentoring, proposal development and reusable GCC/GBS frameworks.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead GCC and GBS strategy and setup or expansion workstreams, converting client objectives into business cases, target operating models, governance structures and implementation priorities.
* Design TOMs, service delivery frameworks, SLAs and performance metrics that clarify accountability, improve service quality and enable measurable operating performance.
* Conduct location strategy, benchmarking, feasibility and cost\-benefit analyses using market, workforce and financial evidence to support defensible investment decisions.
* Manage transition and implementation planning, including milestones, risks, dependencies, change actions and adoption levers that move recommendations into sustained execution.
* Build financial models, process maps and analytical views that identify efficiency, automation and service excellence opportunities across corporate functions.
* Partner with client executives, A\&M leaders and cross\-functional teams to shape solutions, facilitate discussions and deliver clear, high\-quality outputs aligned to strategic priorities.
* Mentor Associates and Analysts while contributing to proposals, pitches, thought leadership and reusable GCC/GBS playbooks that expand team capability and business development impact.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Demonstrated expertise in GBS, GCC or shared services setup, expansion or optimization, with strong understanding of operating model design, process transformation and transition execution.
* Proven ability to develop business cases, financial models, feasibility studies, investment cases and cost\-benefit analyses that support senior client decisions.
* Strong proficiency in Excel modelling, PowerPoint and structured data analysis, with the ability to convert complex findings into concise, client\-ready recommendations.
* Experience with TOM design, benchmarking, governance frameworks, SLAs, performance metrics and service delivery models across corporate functions or global operating environments.
* Familiarity with digital enablement, intelligent automation, analytics solutions or technology\-led transformation, including how these levers improve efficiency and service outcomes.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence interacting independently with senior client executives and leading workstream discussions.
* Strong project management, organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage deliverables, risks and timelines in fast\-paced, global and multicultural teams.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience in a top\-tier consulting firm, Big Four environment or a recognized advisory practice serving global transformation, shared services or operating model clients.
* Exposure to advanced degrees or professional qualifications such as CA, CFA or a master’s degree in Business, Finance or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting proposal development, thought leadership, internal knowledge building or the creation of GCC/GBS frameworks, tools and playbooks.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring 4–7 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years after completing an MBA, with direct exposure to GBS, GCC or shared services strategy, transformation, setup, expansion or optimization.
* You bring the judgment to lead workstreams from structured analysis through client\-ready recommendations, balancing strategic thinking with the practical detail required for transition and implementation.
* You bring strong commercial and analytical capability across business case development, financial modelling, benchmarking, location assessment, process mapping, operating model design and performance measurement.
* You bring clear communication and stakeholder leadership, enabling productive discussions with senior executives while mentoring junior colleagues and maintaining high standards for quality, organization and delivery.
* You bring an action\-oriented consulting mindset: independent thinking, comfort with ambiguity, attention to detail and a commitment to creating tangible business value rather than producing recommendations that cannot be implemented.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At A\&M, you will work where advisory insight and operational execution meet. The GDN Advisory team helps organizations make high\-stakes decisions about operating models, service delivery, talent ecosystems, transformation and technology\-enabled performance. Your work will influence how global businesses structure capabilities, improve efficiency and create measurable value across markets. You will gain exposure to senior client stakeholders, complex cross\-border programs and varied industries while working alongside experienced operators and consultants who value practical results. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and room to shape solutions, relationships and the growth of the practice. You will also benefit from mentorship, structured performance development, technical training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise through A\&M University and internal knowledge platforms. The firm’s commitment to inclusive diversity, wellbeing, flexible support and professional mobility creates an environment where you can grow with purpose. This is an opportunity to build a differentiated career in transformation advisory while helping clients turn stagnation into growth.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Early ownership of meaningful client work across GCC, GBS, operating model and transformation programs, with exposure to senior stakeholders and global industries.
* Structured performance development, technical training, on\-the\-job learning and mentorship that support continuous growth, broader consulting capability and career progression.
* An entrepreneurial, inclusive environment with opportunities for internal mobility, employee resource groups, wellness support, flexible work models and comprehensive benefits.

title: Bid Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vardhman Airport Solutions Ltd. is a leading provider and installer of visual aids, navigational aids, extra low voltage (ELV), and security systems for airports. Based in Delhi, India, the company delivers end\-to\-end solutions including design, site installation, commissioning, and ongoing service support. Vardhman offers flexible engagement models, from turnkey design and installation to product supply, maintenance testing, and dedicated after\-sales services, always focused on customer needs and competitive value. As an authorized distributor for global OEMs such as ATG\-UK, FB Technology (France), RLG Docking Systems (Taiwan), and Unika (Turkey), the company supplies equipment compliant with IEC, FAA, and ICAO standards. Its portfolio covers airfield ground lighting control systems, ELV solutions such as HVAC IBMS, fire alarms, CCTV, access control, and round\-the\-clock maintenance and testing services for airports.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Bid Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating the end\-to\-end bid and proposal process for airport solutions projects. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in West Delhi and involves managing bid preparation, structuring proposal documents, and ensuring timely, high\-quality submissions that align with client requirements and company capabilities. Day\-to\-day tasks include analyzing tender documents, developing bid strategies, liaising with technical, finance, and operations teams to gather inputs, and drafting clear, compliant bid responses. The Bid Manager will track bid schedules, maintain bid documentation, oversee internal reviews and approvals, and support pricing and risk assessments. The role also includes maintaining bid process standards, contributing to continuous improvement, and supporting business development efforts with well\-crafted proposals and presentations.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong skills in Bid Preparation and Bid Writing, including the ability to interpret tender requirements and produce structured, persuasive proposals.
* Candidates should possess experience in Bid Management and Proposal Management, with proven ability to coordinate cross\-functional inputs and manage deadlines.
* Candidates should possess a solid understanding of Bid Processes, including compliance checks, risk assessment, and approval workflows.
* Relevant experience in infrastructure, aviation, or technical solutions bidding will be beneficial, especially familiarity with airport systems and associated standards.
* Strong analytical, written communication, and documentation skills, with attention to detail and the ability to present complex technical information clearly.
* Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, manage multiple bids simultaneously, and work effectively in an on\-site environment in West Delhi.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, management, or a related field; prior experience in a bid or proposal management role is preferred.

title: Account Director, Large Enterprise
description:
**About The Team**
 OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long\-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.
   

  

 In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

 Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value\-driven strategy.
   

  

 You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

* Manage a small number of key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan.
* Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment.
* Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects.
* Own a consumption revenue target.
* Manage consumption revenue forecasts.
* Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.
* Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.
* Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering.
* Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates.
* Support the development of company culture.


**We're Seeking Someone With Experience In**
* 10\+ years selling platform\-as\-a\-service and/or software\-as\-a\-service.
* Achieving revenue targets \>$2M per year for more than 3 years.
* Designing and executing complex deal strategies.
* Supporting the growth of fast\-growing, high\-performance companies.
* Working directly with c\-level executives.
* Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Leading high\-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.).
* Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence.


**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**
* Are customer\-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.
* Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.
* Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.
* Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.
* Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.

AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
   

  

 For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Regional Growth Leaders
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Metafusion is a Unified Video Intelligence Platform provider. A platform that that integrates big video data, Natural Language Processing, computer vision, and Generative AI to unlock the full potential of metadata. Its advanced AI powered video analytics engine enables customers to derive actionable insights through natural language search, visual data interpretation, and on\-the\-fly content generation. This unified platform transforms how users explore and interact with large video data repositories, driving informed decision\-making and innovation. Metafusion’s solutions support a wide range of industries, including Smart and Safe Cities, Surveillance, Traffic and Transportation, Warehousing and Logistics, Hospitality and Healthcare, Banking, and Retail.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





 Growth Leader is Metafusion's revenue engine on the ground — a dual\-mandate leader who drives new business acquisition and nurtures long\-term strategic growth within a defined geographic territory. Beyond classic quota ownership, the growth leader functions as a leader, responsible for mapping the market, building a partner ecosystem, and positioning Metafusion's Vision AI portfolio (Metavisio, Metatraffic, PixelFACE etc) as the intelligence layer of choice across Critical Infra, PSUs, Smart City, Safe City, and Government \& Enterprise verticals.
 



  





 This role requires a commercially assertive, consultatively strong professional who can operate at both the CXO boardroom and the technical evaluation table — owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract closure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**A. Revenue Ownership \& Quota Attainment** 



* Own and exceed the assigned annual revenue quota for the territory per AOP targets.
* Drive end\-to\-end deal closure for Metafusion's Video AI and Vision AI product suite across assigned accounts and geographies.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline coverage at all times, qualifying and progressing opportunities through CRM.
* Deliver accurate sales forecasts of committed numbers on a quarterly basis.



  





**B. Territory Planning \& Market Development** 



* Build and execute a structured Territory Business Plan (TBP) each quarter aligned to AOP priorities.
* Identify high\-potential verticals, critical infra, government bodies \& Enterprises (Police, Smart City, Safe City, ICCC, Traffic, Large Enterprises), PSUs, and other accounts within the territory.
* Map competitive landscape and develop counter\-positioning strategies.
* Track government tenders and proactively position Metafusion in the pre\-tendering stage.
* Maintain a living territory account map: whitespace, installed base, renewal pipeline, and upsell opportunities.



  





**C. Channel Partner \& SI Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, onboard, and enable active channel partners / System Integrators (SIs) within the territory.
* Conduct quarterly partner business reviews, co\-selling, and joint GTM activities.
* Ensure partner pipeline is logged in CRM; manage deal registration and conflict resolution.
* Train partners on Metafusion's product portfolio, solution USPs, and competitive differentiation.



  





**D. Solution Selling \& Pre\-Sales Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Pre\-Sales / Solution Engineers to craft solution architectures, BoQs, and demos tailored to customer needs.
* Lead discovery conversations and translate customer pain points into compelling Metafusion use cases.
* Support RFP / RFI responses for government and enterprise bids, ensuring compliance, differentiation, and on\-time submission.
* Conduct technical evaluation workshops, PoC planning, and site assessment visits alongside Pre\-Sales.



  





**E. CXO Engagement \& Strategic Relationship Management** 



* Build trusted advisor relationships with C\-level and senior decision\-makers at target accounts \& verticals.
* Coordinate with delivery and customer success teams’ post\-sale to ensure smooth implementation and account expansion.



  





**F. CRM Discipline \& Sales Reporting** 



* Maintain 100% CRM hygiene — all opportunities, activities, contacts, and deal stages updated weekly.
* Submit weekly pipeline reports and monthly territory reviews.
* Participate in appraisal cycles with documented evidence against KRA/KPI framework.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




  





**Education** 



* B.E. / B. Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, IT, or related engineering discipline.
* MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management preferred (not mandatory for proven performers).



  





**Experience** 



* 7–8 years of B2B sales experience with at least 3 years in technology / SaaS / Video Surveillance / AI solutions.
* Demonstrated track record of quota achievement.
* Experience selling to Critical Infra, Government (Smart City, Traffic, Safe City), PSUs, or Enterprise accounts is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to tender\-driven procurement processes is a significant advantage.
* Prior experience managing channel partners / SIs in a technology sales context.



  





**Domain Knowledge** 



* Working familiarity with Video Management Systems (VMS), AI Video Analytics, ANPR/LPR, Facial Recognition, or Surveillance infrastructure.
* Awareness of Enterprise Safe City / ICCC / Smart Traffic deployments in the Indian market.
* Understanding of procurement cycles, DPR preparation, and solution architecture basics.



  





**WHY METAFUSION?** 




  




* Work at the intersection of AI, Video Intelligence, and Smart Infrastructure — one of India's fastest\-growing technology domains.
* Opportunity to be a founding GTM team member — shape market strategy, not just execute it.
* Uncapped earning potential.
* Direct access to leadership — flat hierarchy, fast decisions, and merit\-driven career progression.

title: Brand Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Us** 




  





**Tooused** 
 powers circularity for India's leading brands, retailers, textile producers, and households.
 



  





**Tooused's** 
 vision is to divert 1 billion textiles from landfill by 2030, recycling them for a second life instead, and we’re on track to do it with India's first full\-stack textile recycling platform. This platform is setting the course for the future of the industry, connecting textile waste to responsible end\-of\-life options, meaningfully addressing the textile waste crisis, and redefining the sustainability narrative for the next generation – to one that is win\-win\-win for brands, consumers, and our planet.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 We are building
 **TakeBack** 
 for Brands. It gives a brand everything it needs to run its own take\-back programme without building any of it, including reverse logistics across the country, chain of custody on every garment, and the reporting brands will need as India's textile EPR rules take shape.
 



  





 We already have early interest from brands like NewMe, No Nasties, Mahina and Debaans. What we do not have yet is one person who owns this line end to end. That is this role.
 



  





 You will be the first commercial hire on
 **TakeBack** 
 . You will find the brands, run the pitch, close the deal, and then stay on to get the programme live with our ops and tech teams. This is not a role where you hand off after signature. At our stage, the person who sells it is the person who makes it work.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Build and run the brand pipeline, from cold outreach and events to inbound and referrals
* Own the full sales cycle, including discovery, pitch, commercials, negotiation and close
* Design each brand's take\-back programme with them, covering collection format, customer incentive, logistics flow and reporting
* Work with our ops and tech teams to launch signed brands and keep them running
* Be the brand's main point of contact after go\-live, and own renewal and expansion
* Build the pitch materials as you go, including decks, pricing models, and case studies
* Track what is and is not working in the funnel and tell us plainly
* Keep on top of EPR and textile regulation in India, and translate it into a reason for brands to act now



  





**What we are looking for** 





 This is a hands\-on commercial role with responsibility for building the pipeline, winning business, and getting programmes live.
 




  




* **2 to 5 years** 
 in B2B retail sales, partnerships, key accounts, or category management
* Background in fashion, retail, D2C, sustainability
* **Create opportunities proactively:** 
 You will research brands, identify decision\-makers, initiate outreach, and follow up consistently. The founders will support important conversations; you will own keeping opportunities moving.
* **Work towards agreed outcomes:** 
 We will set targets for qualified brand conversations, proposals, signed agreements, and programme launches. A qualified conversation should establish a relevant need, the decision\-making process, and a clear next step.
* **Keep the pipeline current:** 
 Record meaningful activity in our shared CRM or tracker by the next working day. Every active opportunity should show the contact, latest discussion, stage, next action, and follow\-up date.
* **Make progress and blockers visible:** 
 Share a weekly update covering what moved forward, what stalled, why, and what support you need. Raise risks early and recommend a next step.
* **Own delivery with the team:** 
 Confirm operational and technical feasibility before making commitments. After signature, coordinate the launch, track open issues, and keep the brand informed until they are resolved.
* **Ensure continuity:** 
 When an account changes hands or your engagement ends, provide an organised handover covering contacts, commitments, documents, pending actions, and timelines. Another team member should be able to continue the work from those records.



  





**What we are not looking for** 




  




* Someone who only wants to work warm inbound
* Someone who needs a fully built product, a fixed price list, and a finished deck on day one
* Someone who treats sustainability as a talking point rather than an operating problem



  





**Why this is worth your time** 




  





 Textile EPR is coming to India. When it lands, every mid and large apparel brand in the country will need a take\-back partner, and very few will want to build the infrastructure themselves. We already have the grid running. This role is the person who turns that into a business before the rules force everyone to catch up.
 



  





 You will report directly to the founder, and you will own the line rather than a slice of it. If it works, you build the team under it.
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 Fixed salary plus performance\-linked incentive on signed and launched brands. ESOPs on the table for the right person. We will talk numbers openly in the first call.
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 Send your CV to hello@tooused.com with a short note on one brand you think should be running a take\-back programme in India and how you would get to them. We read those notes.

* WhatsApp Marketing

**What are they using AiSensy for?** 




**What are they not using yet?** 




**What business problem can we solve next?** 




**Who are the decision\-makers?**

* Understand customer business priorities and upcoming initiatives.
* Identify whitespace opportunities across products and teams.
* Build quarterly and annual account growth plans.
* Track progress against account\-level objectives.

**4\. Customer Engagement \& Executive Relationships**

* Conduct regular business reviews with enterprise customers.
* Engage senior stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Present AiSensy solutions based on business objectives.
* Share product updates, industry insights, and relevant use cases.
* Identify opportunities to bring AiSensy leadership into strategic conversations.
* Build relationships that support long\-term retention and expansion.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally.



 The goal is to become a
 **trusted business partner** 
 , not just another vendor contact.
 



  





**5\. Product Adoption \& Customer Success** 




 Help customers get more value from AiSensy.
 


* Monitor product adoption and account usage.
* Identify underutilized products and features.
* Educate customers on new AiSensy capabilities.
* Work with Customer Success and Product teams to improve adoption.
* Identify accounts showing declining engagement or usage.
* Build action plans for at\-risk accounts.
* Ensure customer issues are followed through to resolution.
* Collect customer feedback and communicate meaningful insights to Product and Leadership.



  





**6\. Customer Growth Programs** 




 Develop structured programs to increase engagement and business outcomes across enterprise accounts.
 


* Create account\-specific growth and adoption plans.
* Identify high\-impact WhatsApp use cases.
* Share best practices and successful customer use cases.
* Help customers improve their WhatsApp marketing and engagement strategy.
* Drive adoption of new AiSensy products and capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to replicate successful use cases across different teams or business units.



  





**7\. Cross\-Functional Execution** 




 Enterprise accounts require strong internal coordination.
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Sales
* Customer Success
* Product
* Customer Support
* Marketing
* Partnerships
* Engineering
* Leadership



 to ensure smooth execution across strategic accounts.
 



 You will coordinate internal teams, manage expectations, remove blockers, and ensure commitments made to customers are followed through.
 



**You own the outcome—even when multiple teams are involved.** 




  





**8\. Retention \& Account Health**

* Product usage
* Customer engagement
* Revenue
* Expansion
* Renewal
* Support issues
* Customer satisfaction
* Stakeholder relationships



 Identify churn risks early.
 



 Build account recovery plans where required.
 



 Work proactively rather than waiting for the customer to raise a problem.
 



  





**9\. Customer Advocacy \& Strategic Relationships**

* Customer testimonials
* Customer stories
* Webinars
* Events
* References
* Brand Showcase
* Work with Marketing to showcase customer success.
* Build relationships that create opportunities for referrals and introductions.



  





**10\. Reporting \& Account Intelligence**

 Track:
 


* Account revenue
* Expansion revenue
* Product adoption
* Usage
* Renewal status
* Account health
* Pipeline
* Upsell opportunities
* Customer risks
* Key stakeholder relationships



 Maintain accurate CRM records and account plans.
 



 Provide regular updates on:
 



**What's growing?** 




**What's at risk?** 




**What's the opportunity?** 




**What needs leadership attention?** 




  





**What We're Looking For**

 **existing enterprise/B2B accounts** 
 .

* Strong problem\-solving and project management abilities.

* Experience with customer expansion and land\-and\-expand models.
* Experience working with agencies, resellers, or technology partners.
* Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**

* You've successfully expanded relationships from one team/business unit to multiple.

* You can coordinate multiple teams and still own the final outcome.

title: Head - HBDC Business
description:
**Bring more to life.**
 Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
   

  

 At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
   

  

 You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
   

  

 At Cepheid, we are passionate about improving health care through fast, accurate, molecular diagnostic systems and tests. As a member of our team, you’ll get to make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale, within an environment that fosters career growth and development. Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges. Together, we bring MORE change to the world.
   

  

 Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Government Business Lead will be responsible for driving business growth across Central Government, State Government, Public Health Institutions, Autonomous Bodies, Medical Colleges, and National Health Programs. The role requires strong expertise in government procurement, tender management, public\-health funding mechanisms, stakeholder engagement, and channel partner management. The incumbent will identify, influence, and secure opportunities across key national healthcare initiatives including NACO, National TB Elimination Program (NTEP), National Viral Hepatitis Control Program, Virology surveillance programs, Anemia Mukt Bharat, National Health Mission (NHM) programs, and other disease\-control and public health initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Development \& Strategic Account Management**
* Develop and execute government business strategy to drive revenue growth across public healthcare institutions and government agencies.
* Build relationships with key stakeholders across Central /State procurement agencies, State Health Departments, NHM, medical colleges, public sector institutions, and autonomous bodies.
* Identify and qualify opportunities within national and state healthcare programs as well as “CARE” accounts
* Own and manage strategic government accounts, including high\-value institutional and CARES\-funded projects.
* Develop annual territory and account plans to maximize market penetration.


**National Health Program Engagement**
* Drive business opportunities within key public\-health initiatives such as:
+ National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO)
+ National TB Elimination Program (NTEP)
+ National Viral Hepatitis Control Program (NVHCP)
+ National Health Mission (NHM)
+ Anemia Mukt Bharat
+ State and Central Government healthcare projects

* Understand program objectives, budget planning, procurement cycles, and decision\-making frameworks.


**Sales planning, forecasting \& Tender Management**
* Drive business through tenders (Center/State/CARE)
* Manage end\-to\-end tender lifecycle from opportunity identification to order execution.
* Track, nurture opportunity and manage sales through tenders, examples :
+ Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP)
+ Government e\-Marketplace (GeM)
+ Direct procurement routes
+ Rate contracts and framework agreements

* Coordinate with internal teams like Tender, Finance, Logistics, Legal, Order Management etc.. for bid submission, pricing, compliance, documentation, and commercial approvals.


**Funding Landscape Management**
* Develop deep understanding of healthcare funding mechanisms including:
+ NHM budget allocations (PIP/RoP)
+ State healthcare budgets
+ “CARE” Accounts funding landscape, procurement and utilization process


**Channel Partner Management**
* Appoint, manage, and develop channel partners for government business compliantly
* Monitor partner performance against defined KPIs.
* Ensure partner compliance and efficient order execution.
* Lead/Support partners in bid preparation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Regulatory, Finance, Supply Chain, Legal, Tender team, and Service/Application teams.
* Ensure seamless execution from lead generation through order fulfillment.
* Provide market intelligence and customer insights to internal stakeholders.


**Compliance \& Governance**
* Adhere to all applicable government procurement regulations and company compliance policies.
* Maintain accurate opportunity pipeline and forecasting reports.
* Ensure ethical and transparent engagement with all government stakeholders.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Science, Biotechnology or related field.
* MBA or equivalent business qualification preferred.


**Experience Requirements**
* 15 \+ years’ experience in Diagnostics/Healthcare with min 6/7 years of experience in managing Government/Public Business
* Proven experience working with Central Government, State Governments, NHM, public hospitals, medical colleges, and government procurement agencies.
* Demonstrated experience managing opportunities within national healthcare programs such as NACO, TB, Virology, Anemia, NHM, or related initiatives.
* Strong experience in CPPP, GeM, and direct procurement processes and Proven track record in end\-to\-end tender management and successful bid participation.
* Experience managing channel partners and distributors for government business.
* Experience in Team management


**Key Competencies**
* Government Sales \& Key Account Management
* Public Health Program Engagement
* Funding Landscape Analysis
* Strategic Stakeholder Management
* Institutional Sales
* Channel Partner Management
* Negotiation \& Commercial Acumen
* Forecasting \& Pipeline/Funnel Management
* Cross\-functional Leadership
* Team management


 Cepheid, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.
   

  

 Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

description:
As P\&L Lead, you will be accountable for how the client's enterprise customers experience, adopt, and derive lasting value from their Voice AI platform. You will partner deeply with customers, from feasibility and onboarding through to stabilization and long\-term success.This role sits at the intersection of product delivery, execution, customer success, deployment excellence, and business outcomes.
 



  





 You will own the complete customer journey for a set of key accounts, ensuring that every deployment translates into measurable business outcomes. You will work closely with the pod leads and central teams to maintain execution excellence, strong account health, and scalable delivery practices.
 



  





 We are already India's largest Voice AI player, with the strongest product and a clear opportunity ahead. It is time to accelerate a decisive land grab. If you are excited about building at the frontier of AI and turning cutting\-edge technology into transformative outcomes for enterprise customers, this is your playground.
 



  





**What You'll Be Doing** 




  




* Own the P\&L for the assigned portfolio, balancing revenue growth and business outcomes, deliver quality and operational efficiency.
* Run feasibility analysis before signing up new customers, ensuring the right fit and setting up deployments for success from day one
* Manage the complete product delivery lifecycle: onboarding, implementation, go\-live, stabilization, and ongoing success
* Engage deeply with customer stakeholders to understand goals, risks, deployment requirements, and success metrics, acting as a senior trusted partner to their teams
* Drive product delivery, ensuring customers can operationalize their Voice AI agents into their day\-to\-day workflows with measurable business impact
* Plan and execute experimentation cycles, deriving and communicating results and outcomes to both internal and external stakeholders
* Work with Forward Deployment Engineers (FDEs) to build custom solutions tailored to individual customer requirements
* Own internal and external reporting, managing and driving the metrics that reflect both customer health and business performance
* Drive account health, adoption, retention, and expansion readiness through strong execution and consistent value delivery
* Identify risks early, remove blockers proactively, and maintain high standards of delivery quality and customer experience
* Hire, manage, and develop your team, building a high\-performing delivery function over time



**Requirements** 



* 10\+ years of relevant experience across product, product\-led delivery, P\&L Lead, enterprise implementation, customer success, or operations in high\-growth technology/AI environments
* Strong experience managing complex enterprise relationships and driving execution across multiple stakeholders
* Good business understanding \- connecting customer goals, operational execution, and long\-term account success
* Strong technical orientation and comfort working closely with Product and Engineering teams on large\-scale AI or tech\-enabled deployments
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills, especially with senior customer stakeholders
* Ability to thrive in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments where you help shape solutions as much as you deliver them
* Strong ownership mindset, high agency, and ability to build systems instead of relying only on firefighting
* Proven experience in team management, including hiring, mentoring and leading high\-performing cross\-functional teams



  





**Why should you consider us seriously?** 



* We believe that long\-term, people over product and profits, prioritize culture over everything else.
* We are a well\-balanced team of experienced entrepreneurs and are backed by top investors across India and Silicon Valley (Chiratae Ventures, Blume Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Emergent Ventures; Senior execs at Google, Square, Genpact \& Flipkart; Co\-founders of Infosys, Snapdeal, Slideshare, Zomato, etc.)
* Freedom and Responsibility
* Entrepreneurial Team
* Exponential Growth
* Healthcare (Physical \& Mental Wellness)

title: Channel Partner Acquisition Specialist
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for an experienced Channel Partner Acquisition Specialist to build and grow our professional referral network across India. The role focuses on identifying, connecting with, onboarding and activating CA firms, CS firms, corporate service providers, business consultants and other professional intermediaries who work with entrepreneurs, business owners and companies requiring international business setup and corporate services. You will be responsible for developing these professional relationships and converting them into active referral channels for our business setup, UAE Free Zone and international corporate services offerings. This is a commercial channel\-development and relationship\-management role. A CA or CS qualification is not required. This is not an accounting, audit, taxation or company\-secretarial practice role. We are specifically interested in professionals who have previously worked with, sold to, onboarded or managed relationships with CA/CS firms and corporate service providers.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 





 • 
 
 Identify and approach relevant CA firms, CS firms, corporate service providers, business consultants and professional advisory firms across India.
 




 • 
 
 Build relationships with decision\-makers within professional\-services firms and referral networks.
 




 • 
 
 Present our international business setup, UAE Free Zone and corporate services offerings to potential channel partners.
 




 • 
 
 Onboard qualified partners into the company's channel program and ensure a smooth activation
 



 process.
 




 • 
 
 Educate partners on our service portfolio, referral process, commercial model and client journey.
 




 • 
 
 Maintain consistent engagement with onboarded partners to generate qualified client referrals.
 




 • 
 
 Conduct meetings, presentations, calls and follow\-ups with prospective and existing channel partners.
 




 • 
 
 Develop new referral opportunities through networking, professional associations, industry events and direct outreach.
 




 • 
 
 Maintain an organised pipeline of prospective, onboarding and active channel partners.
 




 • 
 
 Coordinate internally with sales, operations and client\-service teams to ensure referred clients receive appropriate support.
 




 • 
 
 Monitor partner activity, referral volumes, conversion performance and relationship health.
 




 • 
 
 Re\-engage inactive partners and identify opportunities to increase referral activity.
 




 • 
 
 Provide market feedback on partner requirements, competitor activity and potential new channel
 



 opportunities.
 




 • 
 
 Represent the company professionally in meetings with external advisors and service providers.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




 The strongest candidates will have practical experience in channel acquisition, channel sales, partner onboarding, referral\-network development or business development involving professional\-service providers.
 



  





**Relevant experience may include working with:** 





 • 
 
 CA and accounting firms
 




 • 
 
 Company Secretary firms

 Corporate service providers

 Business setup or company formation firms
 




 • 
 
 Tax and business advisory firms
 




 • 
 
 Legal or compliance service providers
 




 • 
 
 SME\-focused consultants and professional referral networks
 



 You should be comfortable building relationships from the first conversation through onboarding, activation and ongoing account development.
 



  





**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS** 





 • 
 
 Prior experience building or managing a network of professional referral/channel partners.
 




 • 
 
 Demonstrable experience dealing with CA firms, CS firms and/or corporate service providers.
 




 • 
 
 Strong business\-development, relationship\-management and negotiation skills.
 




 • 
 
 Ability to independently prospect, arrange meetings and develop new professional relationships.
 




 • 
 
 Strong presentation and consultative selling skills.
 




 • 
 
 Ability to understand business setup and corporate\-service solutions and explain them clearly to
 



 partners.
 




 • 
 
 Commercial mindset with a strong focus on partner activation and qualified referral generation.
 




 • 
 
 Comfortable working with CRM systems, partner pipelines and performance reporting.
 




 • 
 
 Strong professional communication skills.
 




 • 
 
 Experience in UAE business setup, Free Zones, international company formation, corporate services or related sectors would be an advantage.
 



  





**IDEAL BACKGROUND** 




**Candidates may come from backgrounds such as:** 





 • 
 
 Channel Sales
 




 • 
 
 Channel Partner Management
 




 • 
 
 Partner Acquisition
 




 • 
 
 Referral Network Development
 




 • 
 
 Business Development
 




 • 
 
 Corporate Services
 




 • 
 
 Business Setup / Company Formation
 




 • 
 
 Fintech or SME Services
 




 • 
 
 Professional Services Sales
 




 • 
 
 B2B2C or intermediary\-led sales models
 



 Experience working directly with a professional network of advisors or service providers will be particularly
 
 relevant.
 




  





**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE** 




**Success will be measured by your ability to:** 





 • 
 
 Build a strong pipeline of relevant professional partners.
 




 • 
 
 Convert prospective partners into active referral relationships.
 




 • 
 
 Develop productive long\-term relationships with CA, CS and corporate\-service networks.
 




 • 
 
 Generate consistent qualified business opportunities through the channel.
 




 • 
 
 Increase the number of active and revenue\-contributing partners.
 




 • 
 
 Maintain disciplined partner follow\-up, reporting and pipeline management.
 



 The role is not focused only on signing partners. The objective is to build a productive and commercially active channel network.
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE**

title: Solution Engineer, Manager
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work** 
 ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

 PURPOSE
   

  

 You will become a member of the border management’s architecture team and provide consulting services to the product and customer delivery teams, helping with guidance throughout the design and development process of our business opportunities. You will also be designing and developing solution architectures to meet business requirements and provide value for money. The ability to be hands\-on and support product and project delivery and transition work is important in addition to an architecture and design role.
   

  

 As Solution Engineer Manager you will have the opportunity to be involved in the end\-to\-end solution process at both the sales and delivery stages of the customer relationship, translating customer aims and requirements into a new solution with agreement through our governance processes.
   

  

 Reporting to the Solution Engineer Director at SITA At Borders, you will be part of a team challenging the status quo, designing solutions that employ strong architecture frameworks and using technologies such as AI/Machine Learning, Biometrics Matching and Identity Management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 As a Manager, Customer Solution Engineering, you will work closely with other members of the Engineering team, supporting, and contributing to all aspects of the role, including:
   

  

* Design/coordinate development of standard and complex solutions which may involve multiple parties both internally and externally including the selection of 3rd party vendors to meet customer requirements. Solutions may support government, border management, immigration, customs, or national security customers operating in mission\-critical environments.
* Support account teams or competency centers during the pre\-contract phases (qualification proposals and contract) with technical designs and advice. Including support for high\-value, long\-cycle government procurement processes such as RFIs, RFPs, and competitive dialogue.
* Provide the technical qualification and own the technical parts of proposals submitted to customers through knowledge of current new or evolving technologies and SITA solution portfolios. Including ownership of technical risk, compliance, and feasibility for large\-scale government and border programs.
* Promote SITA by furnishing customers with comprehensive up\-to\-date information on current products, product enhancements and new solutions through customer meetings and workshops. Leading technical workshops with senior government and operational stakeholders.
* Facilitate designs to be efficiently implemented Right the First Time (RFT) and supported operationally. Ensuring solutions are designed for operability, maintainability, and 24/7 support.
* Collaborate with colleague to gain and share ideas and opportunities. Collaborating across sales, delivery, security, and operations teams.
* Account for designing solutions for large or complex programs in accordance with business strategies, standards, and processes. Designing national\-scale systems with high availability, resilience, and performance requirements.
* Ensure designs in compliance with Industry standards and architectural plans. Ensuring compliance with international, aviation, and border standards such as ICAO, IATA and ISO.
* Lead and coordinate with subject matter experts (SMEs) involved with solution design and subsequent implementation. Acting as solution authority coordinating products, security, infrastructure, and integration SMEs.
* Work with the architects, development, and products engineering teams within the SITA Government business unit to products successful customer designs. Ensuring alignment with product roadmaps, architectural principles, and security frameworks.
* Assess the viability and value of new technologies and patterns, working to ensure we align with the business’s technical aims for scalability and growth. Evaluating emerging technologies in biometrics, identity management, secure integration, and data platforms.
* Understanding of system security. Designing secure\-by\-design solutions including IAM, encryption, network security, and compliance with government security and assurance frameworks.


**Qualifications**
 ABOUT YOUR SKILLS
   

  

* 6–8 years of experience in Information Technology, Telecom Industry or Air Transport Industry technology in a technical pre\-sales role or lead architect role. Experience working with government or public\-sector customers is highly desirable.
* BS level Technical Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering Computer Technologies.
* Ability to provide technical system solutions, determine overall design direction and provide hardware recommendations for complex technical issues. Including solutions operating in mission\-critical and high\-availability environments.
* Experienced in designing, integrating, and managing software solutions. Including large\-scale, multi\-system integrations and legacy interoperability.
* Have a background in working in a systems integration industry. Including delivery of systems\-of\-systems in complex stakeholder environments.
* Proven track record in producing, communicating and documenting successful technical customer solutions. Including high\-level and detailed design documentation (HLD/LLD) for regulated environments.
* Pre\-Sales Business and or Commercial experience is a plus. Including support to government tenders and commercial negotiations.
* Have a very strong solutions \& application architecture background, with a very good understanding how it impacts the other IT disciplines.
* A willingness to keep up to date with developments in new technology.
* An understanding of information legislation, such as the Data Protection Act and GDPR. Including handling of biometric and highly sensitive personal data.
* Ability to demonstrate an understanding of the end\-to\-end solution.
* Deliver and ensure quality assurance against the design during the project phases. Including participation in design governance, reviews, and acceptance milestones.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, and the ability to effectively communicate with technical and non\-technical audiences. Including engagement with senior government and executive stakeholders.
* Problem\-solving and good analytical skills.
* Good organizational skills.
* Flexibility and adaptability.
* Team Player and self starter.


 NICE\-TO\-HAVE
   

  

* Experience in Aviation and borders industry. Including border management, immigration, customs, or law enforcement solutions.
* TOGAF certificate
* ITIL
* Experience with biometric technologies, cloud or hybrid architectures, international border standards, or security certifications.


**What We Offer**

Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.
