title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 4–8 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

description:
**Meet the Team**
 Join Splunk, a Cisco company solution engineering team supporting Public Sector customers and helping organizations address complex security and technology challenges. In this role, you’ll work closely with government and Public Sector organizations, partners, and cross\-functional sales teams to deliver innovative Cisco and Splunk security solutions. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers strengthen their security posture while driving adoption and growth across the portfolio.
   

  

**Your Impact**
**As a Technical Sales Professional, You Will**
* Own the technical relationship with Public Sector customers and partners, serving as a trusted technical advisor and primary technical sales influencer.
* Partner with account and sales teams on strategic account planning, identifying growth opportunities and aligning technical strategies with Public Sector customer objectives.
* Engage with IT and security leaders, technical decision\-makers, and lines of business to understand customer environments, security challenges, business priorities, and technical requirements.
* Translate customer business and security needs into innovative Cisco and Splunk Security solutions and lead strategic solution conversations.
* Design and present cross\-architecture security solutions, demonstrations, and technical presentations that address complex Public Sector challenges.
* Lead technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, helping move opportunities from technical discovery and validation through closure.
* Leverage strong knowledge of Splunk Security technologies, including Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk\-Based Alerting (RBA), Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, Mission Control, and security analytics.
* Apply knowledge of security technologies and architectures including SOC, incident response, threat hunting, XDR/EDR, network security, cloud security, Zero Trust, and security operations to develop relevant customer solutions.
* Leverage competitive market insights to position and differentiate Cisco and Splunk solutions against competing security platforms.
* Coordinate and influence virtual teams of sales resources, security specialists, internal stakeholders, and external partners to drive customer success.
* Provide feedback to Business Entities (BEs) and relevant sales teams on strategic Public Sector customer needs, security trends, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Contribute to demand\-generation, technical enablement, and education initiatives that strengthen Cisco and Splunk security capabilities across the Public Sector.
* Adapt technical and engagement strategies to evolving Public Sector priorities, cybersecurity threats, technology trends, and market conditions.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree with 7\+ years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 4\+ years of related experience, or PhD with 1\+ year of related experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions engineering, security consulting, cybersecurity, or a related customer\-facing technical role.
* Experience engaging with Public Sector customers, IT/security leaders, technical decision\-makers, and business stakeholders.
* Experience designing, presenting, and demonstrating security or technology solutions aligned to customer business challenges.
* Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, security analytics, threat detection, incident response, or security operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with Public Sector or government customers, particularly within complex or regulated environments.
* Strong knowledge of Splunk Security, including Splunk Enterprise Security, SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk\-Based Alerting, Threat Intelligence, and security analytics.
* Experience across XDR/EDR, Network Security, Cloud Security, Zero Trust, Threat Hunting, SOC, and Incident Response.
* Experience driving cross\-sell, up\-sell, competitive displacement, or market\-share growth within strategic accounts.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity trends, customer environments, and competitive security technologies.
* Experience influencing technical executives and leading strategic security solution conversations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Domain Consultant - Identity Security
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
   

  

 Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
   

  

 We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
   

  

 We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
   

  

**Your Career**
 As a
 **Domain Consultant for Identity Security Transformation** 
 , you will be the expert for our
 **Idira Identity Security Platform** 
 , a Next\-Gen AI\-powered identity protection and access management suite. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives while accelerating their Zero Trust journey. You will bridge business requirements with cutting\-edge technical architecture to defend modern enterprise identities across hybrid and cloud environments. By articulating the power of our unified
 **PAM, IAM, Secrets, Agentic AI, Governance, Identity Threat Detection \& Response, and Just\-In\-Time Access** 
 capabilities, you will drive customer transformation to Zero Standing Privileges and establish Idira as an indispensable strategic partner
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Design end\-to\-end identity security architectures integrating Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity Governance \& Administration (IGA), Secrets Management, and Cloud Security Solutions into customer environments.
* Scope, manage, and execute hands\-on technical validation tests and PoVs to demonstrate technical superiority and secure customer buy\-in.
* Deliver compelling technical demonstrations and executive\-level presentations to stakeholders ranging from SecOps engineers to CISOs and CIOs.
* Advise customers on extending zero\-trust principles to non\-human identities, machine credentials, microservices pipelines, and emerging AI agents.
* Educate customers and prospects on the changing identity threat landscape, credential abuse prevention, and modern Zero Trust architecture.
* Work alongside channel partners and system integrators to scale product deployment knowledge and technical messaging.
* Collaborate with account teams to recommend and develop customer solutions within your assigned specialization area
* Present to customers as our expert at all levels in the customer hierarchy, from practitioner to senior leadership
* As the main technical point of contact for Cortex, you will assist and collaborate to respond effectively to RFIs/RFPs.
* Lead and support customer demonstrations that showcase our unique value proposition
* Scope and lead Proof of Value (PoV) projects for prospective customers and partners based on best practices to ensure technical win in your assigned opportunities
* Drive high technical validation and PoV win rates within your assigned specialization area
* Responsible for discussing and highlighting product alignment with customer requirements and differentiation
* Architect solutions that will help our customers strengthen and simplify their security posture
* Document High\-Level Design and Key Use Cases to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks Solutions
* Help our customers build and develop further their services around Cortex solutions
* Lead conversations about industry trends and emerging changes to the security landscape
* Discuss, with credibility, competitive offers in the marketplace and position ours as the best alternative
* Position Palo Alto Networks or Partner delivered services as appropriate to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks solutions
* Act as a conduit for customer feedback to Product Management, Technical Marketing, competitor intelligence, and R\&D to create requirements and deliver product features for our customers


**Qualifications**
**Your Experience**
* 3\+ years’ experience in pre\-sales within high\-tech sales environments, demonstrating a strong track record of success.
* Solid understanding of IAM frameworks, Directory Services (Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID), Single Sign\-On (SSO), MFA, and Federated Access Protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth).
* Hands\-on knowledge of public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and DevOps/CI\-CD automated pipeline security.
* Familiarity with Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, or Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform) for custom integration scenarios.
* Exceptional presentation and technical storytelling skills across both remote and face\-to\-face engagements.
* Strong technology aptitude with the ability to understand and articulate how identity security, cloud, or cybersecurity solutions solve business challenges.
* Solid knowledge of security frameworks and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience with LDAP directories and authentication methods.
* Familiarity with enterprise application authentication technologies such as .NET, Java, and CLI.
* Preferred skills in scripting and application development.
* Highly desirable certifications include CISSP, SANS, AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Cloud Architect
* This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.
* Proficient in English


**The Team**
 Our Domain Consultant team members work hand\-in\-hand with organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.
   

  

 You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers.  As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About The Position**
**About Coralogix**
 Coralogix is a full\-stack observability and security platform \- logs, metrics, traces, and SIEM analysed in\-stream at petabyte scale, stored in the customer's own data lake, and increasingly driven by our agentic AI layer (AI agent Olly, MCP server, CLI). Founded in 2015, headquartered in Boston, and backed by leading investors including Advent International, Brighton Park Capital, and Greenfield Partners with over $500M in funding.
   

  

 What sets Coralogix apart as a platform to build on is the combination of data depth and architectural openness. Because the platform's architecture makes full\-fidelity retention viable at scale, customers hold their complete operational and security picture in their own data lake \- no sampling, no gaps, no third party holding the keys. Every layer is then programmatic \- APIs, SDKs, and dev tools built for custom solutions \- creating an unusually rich and open foundation for the work ahead.ating requisitions 'from scratch'
   

  

**The role**
 Our most strategic customers need more than a platform. They need an engineer who deploys, customizes, and builds alongside them. Enterprise environments are complex \- multiple clouds, legacy infrastructure, custom deployments, multiple tools \- and what these customers need often extends well beyond what any platform delivers as standard.
   

  

 The Forward Deployed Engineer closes that gap. You are an engineer embedded in Tier\-1 accounts, working at the edge of what customers need next \- requirements that evolve continuously as enterprises scale, innovate, and push the boundaries of what observability and security can do for them. This is field\-deployed R\&D. It is not account management and it is not support.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Every engagement starts by getting to the real problem \- translating an ambiguous or evolving customer requirement into a concrete, scoped technical plan before a line of code is written. You build the new functionality that emerges from evolving customer requirements \- net\-new use cases with a clear path to other customers and/or back to the product, customisations that extend existing capabilities where out\-of\-the\-box configurations fall short, and critical features that unlock adoption or expansion with strategic accounts. You build in production\-grade code, not prototypes, working closely with both in\-house and customer observability and security teams \- you build, they define the logic \- ensuring domain validity in everything that ships. AI is central to both how you build and what you build: as a development accelerator and as the core ingredient in your solutions, with a particular focus on autonomous, multi\-step agentic AI workflows. Every engagement is engineered for repeatability, and you work closely with R\&D throughout \- feeding back field patterns and the solutions you have built \- so the best of what you ship is assessed, hardened, and absorbed into the platform. You are accountable for the outcomes in your accounts, not just the builds \- adoption, retention, and time\-to\-value are yours to move.
   

  

**How You Will Work**
 Own 2\-3 strategic accounts (a single account during intensive deployments), operating across the full stakeholder range within each \- from individual engineers and security analysts to CTOs and CISOs. Spend roughly 60\-70% of your time in deep customer engagement, on\-site and virtual, and the remainder on reusable playbooks and structured product feedback to R\&D. Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers, who own the commercial relationship. Exercise judgment on scope continuously \- deciding what matters now versus later, pushing back where needed, and knowing when something is ready to ship so the customer gets real value quickly. Your engagements are time\-bounded with clearly defined outcomes.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 8\+ years in software engineering writing production\-grade code. Prior security or observability experience is a big plus, not a requirement \- you will be paired with experts who provide the domain logic \- but you must ramp quickly into unfamiliar domains.
* A product\-minded engineer with experience designing and building software products end to end \- translating customer needs into product decisions, thinking in user experience and outcomes, and working fluently with modern AI development tools to build AI\-native solution
* Proven customer engagement experience across both technical and non\-technical audiences, including at C\-level \- able to build rapport quickly, explain complex concepts credibly, and navigate an enterprise organisation to get things done.
* Operates with founder\-level ownership: high urgency, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to define the problem as much as solve it.
* A genuine blend of engineering depth and strategic\-consulting instinct.
* Based in\-region, with significant on\-site time at customer sites.


**Strong plus:** 
 detection engineering or security\-operations background; hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-based systems in production, including familiarity with MCP; developer\-platform or SDK building; prior resident\-engineer, forward\-deployed, or strategic\-engineering experience at an observability, data\-infrastructure, or security vendor.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 Replicable use cases delivered and subsequently absorbed into the product; improved time\-to\-value for new enterprise onboarding where you are deployed; stronger retention among your accounts versus baseline; and expansion revenue directly attributable to the capability you have built.
   

  

**How We Work**
 This is a new function \- a small, elite team with a founding mandate. We are entrepreneurial and high\-intensity, operating with unreasonable agency. If you want the deepest applied AI, observability and security engineering work available \- building real solutions for the most demanding enterprise environments, seeing your field\-proven patterns absorbed into a platform used by thousands of engineers globally \- this is where that happens. Think of it as your PhD in applied AI, observability and security: no academic benchmarks, only production.

title: Senior Proposal Manager
description:
The primary function of this role is the leading and managing of international government and commercial proposals across Shield AI’s India business. The BD Ops team is looking for this candidate to have strong technical writing experience, capable of conflating complex technical ideas into succinct prose.
   

  

 The candidate should also have excellent verbal communication and team coordination skills to facilitate contributions from teams across the Shield AI team. In this capacity the proposal manager will be able to support our growing number of proposals and manage, write, and respond to requests for information.
   

  

 Leadership skills:
   

  

* Lead India proposal efforts, align stakeholders, and communicate key customer, market, and BD strategy insights.
* Strong communicator: Strong oral and written communication skills. (Technical writing experience preferred.) Strong presentation skills. Ability to communicate seamlessly at all levels of Shield AI and customer organizations.
* Attention to detail in a fast\-paced environment: Be rigorous and go fast is one of Shield AI’s leadership traits and, possibly, the most relevant one for BD Ops. Our ideal candidate must always work with efficiency and a keen attention to detail. Both are critical to supporting on time, compliant Bids/Proposals and related deliverables.
* Organization and time management: Strong organizational and time management skills enabling the tracking and execution of multiple workstreams with stakeholders across Shield AI.
* BD Ops serves as the primary cross\-functional lead for Bids/Proposals across product lines and geographic regions. We manage the proposal lifecycle from start to finish including kickoff, collaboration with stakeholders, color reviews, and management reviews with senior leaders/executives. We are ultimately responsible for everything that does or does not happen in the Bid/Proposal process.
* The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to be flexible, work hard, hold themself and others to high standards, embrace teammates, and act with kindness.


**What you will do:**
* Manage competing priorities across proposal and other deliverable (WPs, RFIs, ROMs, etc.) development in the fast\-paced environment of the Int’l BD Ops team.
* Lead end\-to\-end proposal execution from pre\-RFP planning through submission and closeout.
* Drive cross\-functional proposal teams to deliver compliant, high\-quality submissions on schedule.
* Continuously improve proposal processes, tools, templates, and best practices.
* Mentor proposal contributors and foster high\-performing, collaborative teams.
* Support India GTM team with briefing and presentation development for customer engagements.
* Support customer meetings, demonstrations, and GTM events as required.
* Provide additional support to BD Ops and GTM team leadership as needed.


**Required Qualifications**
* 2\-4\+ years of Government of India / Indian Ministry of Defence or international government proposal development or BD operations experience.
* In lieu of direct government proposal experience, have 3\+ years of experience working with Government of India or international government requirements.
* Bachelor's degree in business, communication, marketing, engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
* Strong record of academic achievement.
* Experience with proposal methodologies (e.g. Shipley), compliance matrices, and implementing project management tools and processes.
* Proven record of leadership in a professional setting.
* Ability to communicate complex, technical ideas effectively – both orally and in writing.
* Ability to work collaboratively and flexibly as part of a team, embrace the startup environment.
* Ability to work effectively with people at all levels of an organization.
* Demonstrated record of hard work, trustworthiness, holding oneself and others to high standards, and being kind to others.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong technical background especially with unmanned/uncrewed systems and/or autonomy software. \\
* Demonstrated understanding and knowledge of military operations and India defense acquisition processes.
* Understanding of international markets/geopolitical trends in aerospace / defense industry.
* Experience managing Foreign Military Sale and Direct Commercial Sale bids/proposals.

title: Named Account Manager - North
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Your Career**
 The Named Account Manager partners with our customers to secure their entire digital experience. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best\-in\-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero\-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in\-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well\-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 Serve as the go\-to trusted advisor in Identity Security, influencing strategy and deal execution across complex enterprise opportunities.
   

  

* Partner with product, SE, and technical specialists to shape and deliver customer strategies \- driving adoption, modernisation and expansion of PANW Idira solutions.
* Translate complex Identity Security concepts into clear, business\-driven outcomes for executives, demonstrating technical relevance leveraging insights to influence CxO\-level decisions.
* Influence cross\-portfolio demand by identifying and articulating Identity Security needs across large complex portfolios.
* Stay on top of cybersecurity trends, competitor movements, and customer challenges to position PANW as a strategic partner.
* Your consultative selling experience will identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and our customers
* Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions
* Create clear goals and complete accurate forecasting through developing a detailed territory plan
* Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
* Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company\-wide


**Qualifications**
****Your Experience****
* 10\+ years sales experience in Territory sales with a wide\-ranged network in Enterprise accounts in North India region
* Proven to consistently achieve sales goals and experience with closing larger deals
* Experience in direct customer selling role managing north region as terriorty
* Proven track record of successfully closing complex enterprise deals in cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS.
* Demonstrated ability to grow new logos and expand within existing customers.
* Outcome\-oriented with strong commercial judgment.
* Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems
* Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions
* Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring channel\-centric go\-to\-market approach for our customers
* Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process
* Commercial curiosity and the ability to uncover customer pain points through active listening.
* Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes
* Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self\-direction


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

 Give Grants enables large Indian corporations and foundations to deliver maximum social impact. Using a combination of consulting services, operations support and technology platforms, we work with 100\+ companies and grantmakers to make their giving journey convenient, compliant and the most impactful it can be.  The CSR Services team is the primary owner of all client relationships (companies / corporate foundations / philanthropic foundations) and is responsible for overall client delight. Our service offerings include strategy and program design, partner identification, KPI mapping, on\-ground monitoring and evaluation, and overall impact portfolio management. As a Senior Associate in this team, you will be working with the clients and will be required to understand the day\-to\-day operational tasks pertaining to the overall deliverables for the various stakeholders. -

* Graduate/post\-graduate from top\-tier institutes with strong academic background. An academic background in economics / development studies / sociology / social work and other allied streams will be a positive but is not essential.

**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Strong analytical skills, excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills, backed by strong verbal and written communication along with keen attention to detail.
* Technical Skills: Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word. Strong data analysis capabilities. Ability to work with the Google suite of products (Slides, Sheets, Docs).

title: Solutions Architect, Cross Industries
description:
**Description**
* Do you like helping customers solve technical problems?
* Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing technologies?
* Do you have a knack for helping companies understand Emerging Technology Domains such as GenAI, Agentic AI, Analytics , Microservices architectures including the integration approaches?
* Do you thrive on rolling up your sleeves , a Builder who can help Architect new and emerging technologies along with been consultative to ensure success?
* Do you want to be part of the Retail / CPG team helping to establish Amazon Web Services as a leading technology platform for some of the largest Brands \& Customers in India.


 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 As a Solution Architect, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s utility computing web services within strategic accounts and partners. Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the Amazon Web Services technologies as well as broad know\-how around how applications and services are constructed using the Amazon Web Services platform.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess customer\-facing skills that will allow him/her to represent AISPL well within a customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables him/her to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Serve as a key technical member of the Retail/CPG Account team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the Amazon Web Services platform.
* Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Own each technical engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value. (delivery of actual solutions to be done by Amazon Web Services partners)
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
* Understand the Amazon Web Services market segments, customer base, and industry verticals.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the Retail/CPG team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and based out of
   

  

 Delhi
   

  

* As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
* Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
* You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
* As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.


 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

 Want to learn more about being a Solutions Architect at AMAZON, follow the link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=Js21xKMFdww
   

  

**About The Team**
 Retail/CPG Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to some of the largest Brands/Services/Ecommerce customers in India . This customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 3\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* 3\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Sr. Value Engineer
description:
**Opentext \- The Information Company**
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
   

  

**AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 The OpenText Value Engineer is responsible for helping customers realize and validate the business value of their investments in OpenText technologies.
   

  

 This role combines strategic consulting, business transformation advisory, financial modeling, executive engagement, and value realization methodologies to translate technology investments into measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 As a trusted advisor, the Value Engineer partners with Account Executives, Solution Consultants, Enterprise Architects, Customer Success teams, and Business Units to identify customer challenges, quantify business value, build executive business cases, and accelerate strategic transformation. The role also develops scalable, outcome\-focused demonstration use cases that showcase measurable value and enable consistent customer engagement globally.
   

  

**What The Role Offers**
* Conduct executive discovery workshops and customer value assessments.
* Research customer strategies, industry trends, market challenges, and transformation initiatives.
* Identify and quantify business challenges, risks, opportunities, and value drivers.
* Assess AI readiness, cloud modernization opportunities, and digital transformation maturity.
* Translate customer objectives into measurable improvement initiatives and transformation roadmaps.
* Develop executive\-level business cases supporting OpenText investments.
* Create ROI, TCO, cost avoidance, productivity, compliance, and value realization models.
* Support budgetary and investment approval processes through business value articulation
* Create value\-based storytelling assets that align customer challenges to measurable business outcomes.


**What You Need To Succeed**
* Consultative selling and opportunity qualification
* Executive relationship management and strategic account planning
* Value storytelling and executive presentations
* Digital transformation, AI readiness and adoption
* Cloud modernization and information management
* Enterprise architecture and change management
* Demonstration design and storyboarding
* Cross\-product solution mapping

title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 4–8 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

 Weareagileandfocusedontheoverallmakeupoftheteam.Webelievethatwiththeright team \- anything is possible. If you’re looking for an environment that’s fun and friendly but incrediblyfast\-paced;aplacewherewemeasurethetimebetweenreleasesindays;aplace where our focus begins and ends at the consumer \- join us!
   

  

 Role:Engineering Manager — Forward Deployed
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 OneBot deflects contact\-center volume for Deutsche Telekom across nine European markets. The platform strategy has moved from building a single bot we own to running the harness that routes across best\-of\-breed dialog engines — Parloa, ElevenLabs, Wonderful, Decagon and OneBot — with a shared context layer beneath.
   

  

 That split creates two genuinely different engineering jobs. Three PODs build reusable capability: the Router, the Harness capabilities, and the Stability and Acceleration platform. This POD does not build capability. It owns the delivery of use cases inside the NatCos — getting engines live market by market, integrating APIs from systems we do not control, and clearing the business, security and procurement barriers that stand between a working capability and a customer being served by it.
   

  

 Historically that work was squeezed between platform priorities and NatCo deadlines, with no single owner. The result was repeated: multiple divergent integration patterns with vendors, per\-country workarounds, and platform features paused mid\-build. This role exists to own the outcome — and to own it without fragmenting the platform.
   

  

**Delivery Ownership**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of NatCo use cases: from requirement through integration, security clearance, launch and post\-launch quality.
* Hold the launch date. Sequence work across your squads, surface dependencies on the capability PODs early, and escalate rather than absorb.
* Own post\-launch outcomes, not just go\-live — deflection, containment and customer experience are yours after the switch is flipped.


**Partners and vendors**
* Run technology and dialog\-engine partners as delivery partners: onboarding under IT guidelines with defined entry and exit criteria, integration milestones, and SLAs that hold.
* Be the single technical point of contact partners escalate to, and the person who holds them to commitments.


**Stakeholders, security and compliance**
* Work with NatCo business owners, product, PSA, security, privacy and procurement to clear the non\-engineering blockers that stall AI launches.
* Drive security and privacy review to a decision — anticipate what reviewers will ask and bring it before they ask.


**People and team**
* Line\-manage the Forward Deployed Engineers and squad leads: hiring, growth, performance, and building the FDE career path.
* Build a team that is credible in front of a customer and in a code review — deploy engineers into markets without losing their engineering depth.


**Platform discipline**
* Push fixes and patterns discovered in the field back upstream into the owning capability POD, rather than solving them locally.
* Say no to the fast local workaround. Protecting one implementation across nine markets is part of the job, not a constraint on it.


**Must\-have Skills And Experience**
* Experience. 10\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years managing engineers with hiring and performance ownership.
* Hands\-on integration depth. You have personally shipped production integrations against enterprise APIs — REST and event\-driven — in Java, Python or equivalent. You can read the code your team writes and review a design.
* Customer\-facing delivery. You have owned delivery in front of a customer, a partner or an internal business unit, where the commitment was yours and the systems were not.
* Vendor management. Onboarding and managing technology partners: commercial and technical entry criteria, integration milestones, SLA enforcement, and a defined exit.
* Security and compliance fluency. You have taken a product through enterprise security, privacy and procurement review — PSA, DPIA, pen\-test remediation or the equivalent — and know how to shorten it.
* Multi\-market rollout. Rolling the same platform into multiple markets, tenants or customers, and holding one implementation while doing it.
* AI systems literacy. Working knowledge of how modern LLM applications are built and operated: prompts and operating procedures, tool calling and MCP, RAG, evaluation, and voice pipelines including STT, TTS, endpointing and barge\-in. Enough to hold an architectural line in a partner conversation — you are not expected to invent the architecture.
